name: contraceptive
definition: Anything that prevents, or reduces the likelihood of pregnancy.

name: convulsion
definition: Sudden, violent, irregular movement of the body caused by involuntary contraction of muscles and associated with brain disorders, such as epilepsy, fever in children, or with drug or alcohol abuse.

name: corpus cavernosum
definition: Either of the two columns of erectile tissue forming the body of the clitoris (corpus cavernosum clitoridis) or penis (corpus cavernosum penis).

name: corpus luteum
definition: Glandular mass of yellowish tissue in the ovary, formed by a Graafian ovarian follicle that has matured and released its oocyte.

name: cortex
definition: Outer layer of an organ such as the kidney, the cerebellum, or the adrenal gland.

name: cerebral cortex
definition: Outer layer of the cerebrum, composed of folded grey matter, playing an important role in consciousness.

name: cranial placodes
definition: Thickenings in the surface ectoderm of the embryo associated with future eye and ear regions.

name: cranial suture
definition: Line where the bony plates of the skull are joined together by fibrous bands of tissue, easily felt in the newborn before closure by ossification.

name: craniofacial
definition: Pertaining to the cranium and the face.

name: craniorachischisis
definition: Neural tube defect in which both the cranium and vertebral column remain open.

name: cranioschisis
definition: Developmental failure of the cranial sutures to close completely, especially at the occiput, usually leading to grossly defective development of the brain.

name: craniosynostosis
definition: Premature closure of the cranial sutures.

name: cranium
definition: Bony structure surrounding the brain, excluding the bones of the face.

name: Cre/loxP
definition: Bacterial system in which the Cre protein mediates DNA recombination between specific DNA sequences known as lox-P sites.

name: cretinism
definition: Developmental disorder caused by deficiency of thyroid hormone, characterized by severe mental retardation and stunted physical growth, sometimes resulting from maternal iodine deficiency.

name: cri du chat syndrome
definition: Hereditary congenital syndrome due to deletion of the short arm of chromosome 5.

name: crista
definition: One of the inward projections or folds of the inner membrane of a mitochondrion.

name: critical period
definition: Specific time in the development of a biological system when it is particularly vulnerable to injury or misdirection.

name: Crouzon syndrome
definition: Group of autosomal dominant genetic diseases characterized by midfacial hypoplasia, craniosynostosis, exophthalmos, and a shortened head.

name: crypt
definition: Small tubular gland, pit, or depression.

name: cryptophthalmos
definition: Failure of the eyelids to develop with a fissure between them, usually with defective formation of the eyeballs.

name: cumulus oophorus
definition: Mass of follicular cells surrounding the oocyte in the Graafian follicle.

name: cyanosis
definition: Bluish discoloration of the skin and mucous membranes due to excessive concentration of deoxygenated haemoglobin, owing to poor circulation or inadequate oxygenation of the blood.

name: reproductive cycle
definition: Cycle of physiological changes in the female reproductive organs, from the time of fertilization of the oocyte through gestation and parturition.

name: cyclopia
definition: Rare form of holoprosencephaly, a congenital disorder characterized by a single orbital fossa due to the failure of the embryonic prosencephalon to divide the orbits of the eye correctly into two cavities.

name: cyst
definition: In an animal or plant, thin-walled hollow organ or cavity containing a liquid secretion. Sac, vesicle, or bladder.

name: cytogenetics
definition: Branch of genetics in which the structure and function of chromosomes and of other cell constituents concerned with heritable properties and their expression are studied.

name: cytomegalovirus
definition: Type of Herpes virus that usually produces very mild symptoms in an infected person but may cause severe neurological damage in people with weakened immune systems and in the newborn.

name: cytotrophoblast
definition: Inner cellular layer of the trophectoderm (trophoblast); part of the mammalian placenta.

name: Daphnia magna reproduction test
definition: Procedure in which young female Daphnia are exposed to a substance added to the water and numbers of living offspring and surviving parent organisms are recorded.

name: decidua
definition: Modified endometrial layer that lines the uterus during pregnancy and is shed with the afterbirth.

name: decidual cell
definition: Enlarged, ovoid, connective tissue cell appearing in the endometrium during pregnancy.

name: decidual cell response technique
definition: Biological test method in which pseudopregnant rats undergo a surgical treatment of the uterus to induce uterine differentiation and proliferation, resulting in massive tissue growth that mimics the response of the uterus during normal blastocyst implantation.

name: decidualization
definition: Changes in response to progesterone that include the eosinophilic proliferation around arterioles after ovulation or progesterone action on endometrium.

name: deciduum
definition: Swelling of a uterine crypt produced by its reaction to an implanted embryo.

name: decussate
definition: Pertaining to two or more things that cross or intersect each other to form an X.

name: defeminized gonadotropin secretion
definition: Gonadotropin secretion without female sex hormones.

name: demasculinized
definition: Describing a male animal from which the testicles have been removed.

name: dermis
definition: Layer of the skin deep under the epidermis, consisting of a bed of vascularized connective tissue and containing the nerves and organs of sensation, the hair roots, and sebaceous and sweat glands.

name: desynapsis
definition: Failure of synapsis due to separation of homologous chromosomes after initial pairing in meiosis.

name: developmental biology
definition: Study of biological development from fertilization to adulthood, usually with an emphasis on the prenatal period and regulation of morphogenesis, and neural development on through adolescence.

name: developmental neurotoxicity study
definition: Procedure in which female rodents are exposed to a test substance from the time of implantation through all of lactation; offspring may be exposed during the preweaning period, either directly or through milk, and are studied with regard to neurologic and behavioral abnormalities during postnatal development and until adulthood.

name: developmental susceptibility gene
definition: Any gene that encodes a gene product that can be altered by environmental agents to cause disturbance of normal development.

name: developmental toxicology
definition: Study of adverse effects on the developing organism that result from exposure of either parent to an agent or substance prior to conception, of the mother and fetus during prenatal development, and of the child from birth until the time development is completed.

name: dextrocardia
definition: Congenital defect in which the apex of the heart is directed toward the right side of the thorax (isolated dextrocardia), or the heart is found in a mirror image position on the right side of the body (dextrocardia situs inversus).

name: dextroposition
definition: Displacement to the right.

name: DiGeorge syndrome
definition: Condition caused by the deletion of a small piece of chromosome 22 near the middle of the chromosome at a location designated 22q11.2.
synonyms: DGS|DiGeorge anomaly|Shprintzen syndrome|Strong syndrome|congenital thymic aplasia|conotruncal anomaly face syndrome|thymic hypoplasia|velocardiofacial syndrome

name: diaphragm
definition: Dome-shaped muscular membranous partition separating the thoracic cavity from the abdominal cavity in mammals.

name: diathesis
definition: Hereditary predisposition to a particular medical condition.

name: diencephalon
definition: Posterior part of the forebrain (prosencephalon), containing the hypothalamus and other thalamic components and enclosing the third ventricle.

name: diethylstilbestrol
definition: Synthetic nonsteroidal substance with estrogenic activity.

name: diploid
definition: Cell or nucleus containing two complete sets of chromosomes, one from each parent, or an organism composed of such cells.

name: embryonic disc
definition: Bilayer plate of cells in the blastocyst from which the mammalian embryo develops.

name: dispermy
definition: Entrance of two spermatozoa into one egg.

name: disruption
definition: Disturbance that interrupts a process or disorganizes a structure.

name: distal
definition: Situated away from the centre of the body or from the point of attachment.

name: diverticulum
definition: Outpouching of a hollow structure in the body, that may be acquired (as in colonic diverticulitis) or be present at birth (e.g., Meckel diverticulum or Zenker diverticulum).

name: dominant
definition: Of a gene, determining the phenotype even when present only in one copy or inherited from only one parent.

name: dorsal
definition: On or relating to the upper side or back of an organism.

name: drug metabolizing enzyme
definition: Any enzyme that metabolizes xenobiotics.

name: duct
definition: Vessel for transporting fluids such as lymph, or glandular secretions such as tears or bile.

name: ductus arteriosis
definition: Fetal blood vessel connecting the pulmonary artery to the proximal descending aorta.

name: dung fly test
definition: Procedure using dung flies of the order Diptera where a test substance is mixed with bovine feces to which eggs of the fly are added; number, sex, and morphology are determined when the last adult has emerged.

name: duodenum
definition: First portion of the small intestine, between the stomach and the jejunum, where bile and pancreatic digestive juices enter the intestinal tract.

name: dysgenesis
definition: Defective or abnormal development of an organ.

name: dysgonesis
definition: Dysgenesis of the gonads.

name: dysmenorrhea
definition: Difficult and painful menstruation.

name: dysmorphia
definition: Abnormality of shape of a body part or organ, often referring to a birth defect.

name: dysmorphogenesis
definition: Production of dysmorphia.

name: dysplasia
definition: Abnormal development of an organ or tissue identified by morphological examination.

name: dysostosis
definition: Defect in the normal ossification of fetal cartilage.

name: early life stage test
definition: Toxicity test using an organism in an early life stage such as the embryo or larva, noting that this stage is often the most sensitive part of the species life cycle.

name: earthworm reproduction test
definition: Procedure in which adult worms (Eisenia sp.) are exposed to a test substance mixed into the soil; number, weight and behaviour of the adult worms are studied after four weeks and the number of juveniles hatched is counted after a further four weeks.

name: eclampsia
definition: Acute, life-threatening complication of pregnancy characterized by tonic-clonic seizures (convulsions), usually in a woman who has developed pre-eclampsia.

name: ecogenetics
definition: Study of the influence of hereditary factors on the response of individuals or populations to environmental factors.

name: ectoderm
definition: In an embryo, outermost layer that develops into the epidermis of the skin and the nervous system.

name: ectopia
definition: Abnormal location or malpositioning of an organ or body part, usually congenital.

name: ectopic expression
definition: Expression of a gene in a tissue in which it is not normally expressed.

name: ectopic pregnancy
definition: Complication of pregnancy in which the embryo implants (see implantation) and develops outside the cavity of the uterus.

name: ectrodactyly
definition: Congenital absence or deficiency of one or more of the central digits of the hand or foot.

name: ectrosyndactyly
definition: Congenital absence or deficiency of one or more of the central digits of the hand or foot with fusion of the existing ones.

name: edema
definition: Presence of abnormally large amounts of fluid in body cavities and intercellular spaces of tissues.

name: efferent duct
definition: Seminal duct leading from the testis to the head of the epididymis.

name: egg
definition: Female gamete after completion of the second meiotic division.

name: ejaculation
definition: Expulsion of semen from the genital ducts and urethra, usually resulting from a reflex process during sexual stimulation

name: ejaculatory duct
definition: Passage formed by the junction of the duct of the seminal vesicles and the ductus deferens through which semen enters the urethra.

name: electroporation
definition: Means of introducing molecules into cells by transiently permeabilizing their membranes with brief electric field pulses.

name: embryogenesis
definition: Development and growth of an embryo in the period from formation of the bilaminar embryo to the beginning of the fetal period (in humans, the second through the eighth week after conception).

name: embryoid body
definition: Structure resembling an embryo which is formed by embryonic stem cells or teratocarcinoma cells when they are removed from a growth-promoting medium.

name: embryonic induction
definition: Process whereby the development of one group of cells, called the competent region, is altered by an inducing factor from another group, called a signaling center or organizer.

name: embryo transfer
definition: Process of implanting a fertilized ovum into a uterus.

name: embryo transport rate analysis
definition: Method to evaluate the potential for early embryonic loss in rodents caused by accelerated or retarded arrival of embryos into the uterus.

name: embryology
definition: Science of the origin and development of the organism from fertilization of the oocyte to the beginning of fetal life (in humans, the end of the eighth week).

name: embryonic period
definition: Period from fertilization to the end of major organogenesis.

name: embryonic stem cell
definition: Undifferentiated, pluripotent cell from an early stage of the pre-implantation embryo (inner cell mass of the blastocyst).

name: encephalitis
definition: Inflammation of the brain.

name: encephalocele
definition: Congenital protrusion of brain tissue through a fissure or defect in the skull.

name: endocardial cushion
definition: Subset of cells in the primordial tube-like heart that is essential to the development of the ventricular septum and the atrioventricular valves of the heart.

name: endocardium
definition: Endothelial lining of the heart chambers, also containing small blood vessels and a few bundles of smooth muscle, continuous with the endothelium of the great blood vessels.

name: endochondral ossification
definition: Formation and growth of bone tissue (especially of the long bones) during fetal development of the mammalian skeletal system, and in repair of bone fractures, that takes place in the presence of cartilage.

name: endocrine
definition: Pertaining to hormones or to glands that secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream.

name: endocrine disrupter
definition: Exogenous substance that, at some dose, alters function(s) of the endocrine system and consequently causes adverse health effects in an intact organism, its progeny, or (sub)populations.

name: endoderm
definition: Innermost of the three primary germ layers of an embryo, developing into the gastrointestinal tract, the lungs, and associated structures.

name: endometrium
definition: Inner lining of the uterus that is shed during menstruation.

name: endothelium
definition: Layer of flat cells that line the blood vessels, lymphatic vessels, and the chambers of the heart.

name: environmental factor
definition: Physical, chemical, or biological agent or condition in the environment that has the potential to affect development and health of an organism, either in a positive or a negative manner.

name: epaxial
definition: Located above or on the dorsal side of an axis.

name: epiblast
definition: Primitive ectoderm of the early embryo.

name: epicardium
definition: Inner layer of the pericardium, a sac of fibrous tissue that surrounds and lies upon the heart and the base of the great vessels.

name: epidemiology
definition: Study of the distribution and determinants of health-related states or events in specified populations and the application of this study for the control of health problems.

name: epidermis
definition: In vertebrates, protective outer stratified squamous layer of the skin consisting mainly of keratinocytes.

name: epididymis
definition: Tightly-coiled, thin-walled tube that conducts sperm from the testis to the vas deferens.

name: epididymal appendix
definition: Cystic structure sometimes found on the head of the epididymis.

name: epilepsy
definition: Chronic neurological disorder marked by sudden recurrent episodes of sensory disturbance, loss of consciousness, or convulsions, associated with abnormal electrical activity in the brain.

name: epiphyseal plate
definition: The disk of hyaline cartilage between the metaphysis and the epiphysis of an immature long bone that permits the bone to grow longer.

name: epispadias
definition: Malformation in which the urethra does not develop to full length, opening typically on the dorsum of the penis (and rarely, in females, between the clitoris and labia); frequently associated with exstrophy of the bladder.

name: epistasis
definition: Situation in which the phenotypic expression of one gene obscures the phenotypic effects of another gene.

name: epithelium
definition: Sheet of one or more layers of cells covering the internal and external surfaces of the body and hollow organs.

name: epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition
definition: Sequence of events, where epithelial cells detach, migrate, and become mesenchymal stem cells that can differentiate.

name: epoxide hydrolase
definition: Detoxification enzyme (EC 3.3.2.9), located mainly in the endoplasmic reticulum, that hydrolyzes epoxides, converting them to metabolites that can be more rapidly excreted.

name: erectile dysfunction
definition: Inability of a male to have or to maintain an erection.

name: estradiol
definition: Steroid sex hormone, involved in many regulatory processes, but most prominently in the development of female sex organs, the menstrual cycle, and pregnancy.

name: estriol
definition: Hormonally active metabolite of estradiol, eliminated in urine, especially during pregnancy.

name: estrogen
definition: Any substance, natural or synthetic, that exerts the hormonal effects of the natural estrogen, estradiol, usually by interaction with the estrogen receptor.

name: in vitro estrogen activity assay
definition: Procedure in which a tumor cell line is exposed to a test substance and activation of the estrogen receptor is studied by a reporter molecule in order to assess the estrogen-sensitivity of the tumor. Test using estrogen-sensitive cells to evaluate estrogenic activity of a substance or environmental sample.

name: estrogen-mimetic
definition: Behaving like an estrogen.

name: estrogenic
definition: Exhibiting hormonal activity similar to that of estrogens.

name: estrous cycle
definition: Sequence of recurring physiological uterine, ovarian, and other changes, induced by reproductive hormones in higher female animals, resulting in readiness for insemination. This cycle starts in adulthood (at menarche), transiently discontinues during pregnancy, and disappears at the menopause.

name: estrus
definition: Recurrent period of sexual receptivity and arousal in the female of most mammals except the higher primates, during which conception is possible.

name: estrus syndrome
definition: Persistent estrus caused by elevated estrogenic activity, either due to endogenous estrogens (e.g., in polycystic ovary syndrome) or due to exogenous substances.

name: euploid
definition: Referring to a cell or organism with chromosomes present in an integral multiple of the haploid number.

name: eutherian
definition: Subclass of mammals having a placenta through which the fetus is nourished.

name: eventration
definition: Protrusion of omentum and/or intestine through a defect or weakness in the abdominal wall while the skin remains intact.

name: evocation
definition: Specific induction of a tissue within a developing embryo that results from the action of a single hormone or other chemical (the evocator).

name: excurrent
definition: Pertaining to a vessel (or opening) conveying fluid outwards.

name: exencephaly
definition: Exposed brain resulting from failure of the neural tube to close and absence of the top of the skull.

name: exocrine
definition: Relating to or denoting glands that secrete through ducts opening on to superficial epithelium (e.g., the intestinal tract) rather than into the blood.

name: exomphalos
definition: Hernia in which bowel or omentum protrudes through the abdominal wall under the skin at the umbilicus.

name: exophthalmia
definition: Marked protrusion of the eyeballs, usually resulting from an increased volume of the orbital contents.

name: expressed sequence tag
definition: Partial or full complementary DNA sequence that can serve as a marker for a region of the genome that encodes an expressed product.

name: exstrophy
definition: Congenital malformation in which a hollow organ has its interior exposed through eversion; most commonly observed in the urinary bladder (ectopia vesicae).

name: external genitalia
definition: Genitalia visible outside the body.

name: extracellular matrix
definition: Mesh of molecules, secreted by cells into the surrounding extracellular space.

name: extraembryonic membrane
definition: One of the membranes that surrounds the embryo, which include the yolk sac, allantois, amnion, and chorion.

name: extraembryonic mesoderm
definition: Cells outside the embryo that, although derived from the zygote, are not part of the embryo proper and contribute to the fetal membranes (yolk sac, allantois, amnion, and chorion).

name: extrinsic pathway
definition: Apoptotic pathway of cell death initiated upon occupancy of so-called death receptors at the cell surface with their ligands, such as Fas/CD95 and tumor necrosis factor-\(\upalpha\), and involving activation of caspase 8.

name: F1 generation
definition: Indicating ‘first filial’ generation, denoting offspring from genotypically (see genotype) distinct parents.

name: facial cleft
definition: Congenital anomaly resulting from the failure of facial structures in the embryo to fuse properly.

name: facies
definition: In medicine, facial expression of an individual that is typical of a particular syndrome, disease, or condition.

name: fallopian tube
definition: One of a pair of tubes, on either side of the upper or outer extremity of the ovary, that provides a path by which an ovum travels from the ovary to the fundus of the uterus.

name: fecundation
definition: Process of fertilization.

name: fecundity
definition: Ability to produce offspring within a given period of time. Quantity of reproductive output.

name: feminization
definition: Development of female characteristics as part of normal female maturation, or, in a male, pathologically as a result of endocrine imbalance.

name: female fertility
definition: Ability to conceive (see conception). Production of live offspring.

name: male fertility
definition: Ability to induce conception.

name: Fertility Assessment by Continuous Breeding
definition: Reproductive toxicity test in rodents in which female animals are repeatedly mated and frequency and size of litter and other parameters are measured; second or later generation fertility is also studied.

name: fertilization
definition: In reproductive biology, union of male and female gametes to form a zygote from which an embryo can develop.

name: fetal alcohol syndrome
definition: Condition developing in the fetus and resulting in congenital abnormalities, caused by alcohol intake by the mother during pregnancy, typically characterized by decreased cognitive development, stunted growth and a characteristic facies.

name: fetal pole
definition: Thickening on the margin of the yolk sac of a fetus during pregnancy.

name: FETAX
definition: Assay for teratogenicity using embryos of the frog, Xenopus laevis.
synonyms: frog embryo teratogenesis assay Xenopus|frog embryo teratogenesis assay Xenopus

name: fetoscopy
definition: Procedure in which a fetus may be directly observed in utero, using a fiber-optic endoscope (fetoscope) introduced through a small incision in the abdomen under local anesthesia.

name: fetus
definition: Young mammal within the uterus of the mother, from the visible completion of characteristic organogenesis until birth.

name: fibroblast
definition: Flat fibrous tissue cell, with stellate or spindle shape, associated with the formation of collagen fibers and intercellular extracellular matrix.

name: fibroblast growth factor
definition: Any member of a family of more than twenty protein growth factors involved in angiogenesis, wound healing, and, in early embryonic development, induction of mesoderm, patterning and morphogenesis, and development of the limbs and brain.

name: fish embryo test
definition: Procedure in which fish (often zebrafish, Danio rerio) eggs and embryos are exposed to a test chemical and subsequent development or death of the animals is studied.

name: fish reproduction assay
definition: Procedure in which sexually mature male and spawning female fish are exposed to a test substance and multiple endpoints, including egg production, endocrine activity, vitellogenin, and gonadal histopathology are measured.

name: fish sexual development test
definition: Procedure in which fish are exposed from the time of fertilization of the egg until sexual differentiation is completed and markers of possible endocrine disruptor activity are studied, including vitellogenin concentration, gonadal histopathology, sex ratios, and the occurrence of intersex.

name: fistula
definition: Permanent abnormal passage from an internal organ to the body surface or between two internal organs or structures.

name: fitness
definition: Ability to survive and reproduce.

name: hepatic flexure
definition: Bend between the ascending colon and the transverse colon.

name: foetus
definition: Alternative spelling of fetus found in British English usage.

name: folic acid
definition: Water-soluble B vitamin involved in breakdown of carbohydrates, releasing energy and promoting biosynthesis.

name: follicle
definition: Small, secretory sac, such as the dental follicles that enclose the teeth before eruption or the hair follicles within the epidermis. Fluid- or colloid-filled ball of cells in some glands such as the thyroid gland and the ovaries.

name: follicle-stimulating hormone
definition: Hormone secreted by the anterior pituitary that stimulates the Graafian follicles of the ovary and subsequent follicular maturation, and in the male contributes to inducing spermatogenesis.

name: follicle-stimulating hormone releasing hormone
definition: Hormone, released by the hypothalamus, inducing the secretion of follicle-stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone by the pituitary gland.

name: follicular atresia
definition: Degeneration and resorption of an ovarian follicle before it reaches maturity and ruptures.

name: follicular phase
definition: First half of the human menstrual cycle, during which one or more follicles in the ovary may mature, culminating in ovulation.

name: fontanelle
definition: Any of several soft spots in specific locations on the skull of the newborn where the bones have not yet fused and the brain is covered by skin and a tough membrane.

name: foramen
definition: Opening, hole.

name: foramen magnum
definition: Large foramen in the base of the skull, through which the spinal cord passes.

name: foramen ovale
definition: In the fetal heart, opening that allows shunting of blood between the right and left atria and normally closes at birth. One of the larger foramina in the base of the skull.

name: forward genetics
definition: Approach to genetic investigation in which the aim is to identify the gene that governs a particular function.

name: fossa
definition: In anatomy, a depression or hollow, often in a bone.

name: fossa ovalis
definition: Oval depression in the heart, on the lower part of the septum of the right atrium.

name: frontonasal dysplasia
definition: Congenital malformation of the midface in which the nose has a flat, wide appearance, the eyes may be wide-set, and there is a groove of varying size, running down the middle of the face across the nose.
synonyms: FND|Tessier cleft numbers 0/14|frontonasal dysostosis|frontonasal malformation|median cleft face syndrome

name: functional genomics
definition: Development and implementation of technologies to characterize the mechanisms through which genes and their products function and interact with each other and with the environment.

name: fundus
definition: Part of a hollow organ (e.g., the uterus) that is furthest from its opening.

name: gall bladder
definition: Pear-shaped muscular sac underneath the liver that stores bile secreted by the liver before its release into the duodenum.

name: gamete
definition: Reproductive cell (e.g., sperm or egg) containing a haploid set of chromosomes.

name: gamete intrafallopian transfer
definition: Technique of assisted reproduction by placing eggs and sperm into a woman’s Fallopian tubes in order that fertilization may occur there.

name: gametogenesis
definition: Development of male or female gametes to maturity.

name: gastroschisis
definition: Congenital defect characterized by a fissure in the anterior abdominal wall through which the small and (or) large intestine protrude.

name: gastrula
definition: Embryonic stage that develops from two to three germ layers during gastrulation.

name: gastrulation
definition: Stage of embryo development in which the two-layered blastula transforms into the gastrula by developing ectoderm and endoderm, as well as a third layer (mesoderm), through the movement of specific cells.

name: gene product
definition: Both the messenger RNA resulting from transcription of a gene and the proteins and peptides translated from that mRNA.

name: gene silencing
definition: Prevention of the expression of a specific gene.

name: gene targeting
definition: Use of homologous recombination to change a gene, e.g., to delete a gene, remove exons, add a gene, or introduce point mutations.

name: genital
definition: Of or relating to human or animal reproduction. Of or relating to the genital organs. Of or relating to the final stage of psychosexual maturation.

name: genitalia
definition: Plural of genital. Externally visible sex organs.

name: genital fold
definition: Embryonic structure that will develop into the penis and scrotum in males or the labia in females.

name: genital organ
definition: Organ of reproduction or generation, both external and internal to the body.

name: genital tract
definition: Genital passages of the urogenital apparatus.

name: genital tubercle
definition: Primordium of the penis or clitoris.

name: genotoxic
definition: Capable of causing a change to the structure of the genome.

name: germ cell gene mutation assay
definition: Procedure in which mutations induced by an agent are studied in germ line cells or somatic stem cells from a transgenic animal (rodent), containing reporter genes for detection of various mutations.

name: germ line cell
definition: Gamete or an embryonic cell that can develop into a gamete.

name: germ layer
definition: Any of three distinct layers of cells (endoderm, ectoderm, and mesoderm) that become recognizable as the embryo develops.

name: gestation
definition: Period between conception and birth during which an embryo or fetus is carried in the uterus of a female mammal.

name: gestation period
definition: Time from conception to birth, during which a fetus develops.

name: gigantism
definition: Condition of abnormal size or overgrowth of the entire body or of any of its parts.

name: gland
definition: Organized aggregation of cells functioning as a secretory or excretory organ.

name: glans
definition: Any small rounded mass or gland-like body.

name: glans clitoridis
definition: Rounded mass of sensitive erectile tissue that forms the head of the clitoris.

name: glans penis
definition: Rounded mass of sensitive erectile tissue at the distal end (head) of the penis, analogous to the glans clitoridis.

name: glaucoma
definition: Disease of the eye characterized by increased intraocular pressure, resulting in atrophy of the optic nerve.

name: glomerulus
definition: Tuft or a cluster, as of a plexus of capillary blood vessels or nerve fibers (e.g., capillaries of the filtration apparatus of the kidney).

name: glucocorticoid
definition: Any of a group of steroid hormones, such as cortisone, produced by the adrenal cortex, inhibiting inflammation, and mediating a response to stress that alters protein, fat, and carbohydrate metabolism.

name: glycolysis
definition: Biochemical breakdown of glucose into pyruvic acid with the production of ATP.

name: gonad
definition: Organ in animals that produces gametes, i.e., the testis or the ovary.

name: gonadotropin
definition: Glycopeptide hormone, produced by the fetal placenta, that maintains the function of the corpus luteum during the first few weeks of pregnancy.

name: gonadotropin-releasing hormone
definition: Any factor from the hypothalamus that stimulates the anterior pituitary to release both follicle-stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone.

name: Graafian follicle
definition: Mature ovarian follicle within which an oocyte attains full size and which ruptures during ovulation to release the ovum.

name: granulocyte
definition: White blood cell, distinct from a lymphocyte, containing cytoplasmic granules.

name: granulosa
definition: Pertaining to cells of the cumulus oophorus.

name: grey matter
definition: Regions of the brain and spinal cord that are made up primarily of cell bodies and dendrites of nerve cells rather than of myelinated axons.

name: growth factor
definition: Naturally occurring or genetically engineered protein or steroid hormone that binds to a receptor to regulate cell growth, proliferation, or differentiation.

name: growth hormone
definition: Peptide hormone secreted by the anterior pituitary that stimulates growth, energy metabolism, and cell proliferation.

name: growth hormone releasing factor
definition: Substance produced in the hypothalamus that regulates release of growth hormone by the anterior pituitary.

name: gubernaculum
definition: Fetal mesenchyme ligament that passes through the anterior abdominal wall and connects the lower pole of each developing gonad with the developing scrotum in men, and with the developing labia majora in women.

name: haploid
definition: State in which a cell contains only one set of chromosomes.

name: hemal
definition: Pertaining to blood or blood vessels. Situated, in common with the heart and major blood vessels, on the ventral side of the body with respect to the vertebral column or its embryonic precursors.

name: hemangioma
definition: Benign tumor formed by a vascular malformation present at birth or developing during life, in which proliferation of blood vessels leads to a vascular tangle.

name: hematopoiesis
definition: Development of each of the types of blood cell from common precursor cells, located mainly in the bone marrow.

name: hemimelia
definition: Congenital partial absence of all or part of the distal half of a limb.

name: hemivertebra
definition: Congenital defect of the vertebral column in which one side of a vertebra fails to develop completely due to failure of the chondrification center to form on that side.

name: hemolytic disease of the newborn
definition: Severe form of anemia in a fetus or newborn infant caused by incompatibility with the mother’s blood type, typically when the mother is rhesus factor negative (Rh -ve) and produces antibodies which attack (Rh +ve) fetal blood through the placenta.

name: hepatosplenomegaly
definition: Enlargement of the liver and spleen.

name: hermaphrodite
definition: Having the reproductive organs and many of the secondary sex characteristics of both sexes.

name: hermaphroditism
definition: State of being hermaphrodite.

name: hernia
definition: Protrusion of an organ or structure through an abnormal opening in connective tissue or in the muscle wall of the cavity in which it is normally enclosed.

name: hiatal hernia
definition: Hernia of a part of the stomach through a rupture of the diaphragm at the esophageal opening.

name: herpes
definition: Family of viruses including herpes simplex types 1 and 2, and herpes zoster (also called varicella zoster).

name: Hershberger bioassay
definition: Short-term in vivo procedure in which the androgenic or antiandrogenic effects of a test substance are studied in castrated, peripubertal male rodents, as indicated by changes in the weights of androgen-dependent tissues.

name: hippocampus
definition: Structural component of the limbic system of the vertebrate brain involved in short-term and long-term memory and spatial navigation.

name: Hirschsprung syndrome
definition: Absence of nerve ganglia throughout all or part of the gastrointestinal tract, causing dysregulation of intestinal motility.

name: hirsutism
definition: Presence of excessive bodily and facial hair.

name: holoprosencephaly
definition: Birth defect in which the embryonic forebrain fails to divide completely to form the cerebral hemispheres.

name: homeobox
definition: Any of a class of closely similar DNA sequences occurring in various genes and involved in regulating pattern formation, segmentation, and morphogenesis during embryonic development in many species.

name: homeobox gene
definition: Gene containing a homeobox sequence.

name: homeosis
definition: Replacement of part of one segment of an insect or other segmented animal by a structure characteristic of a different segment, especially through mutation.

name: homologous
definition: Having the same relationship, relative position, or structure. (Of organs) Similar in position, structure, and evolutionary origin but not necessarily in function. (Of chromosomes) Pairing at meiosis and having the same structural features and pattern of genes. (Of a series of chemical compounds) Having the same functional group(s) but differing in structure by a fixed group of atoms.

name: homologous recombination
definition: Crossing over between two similar or identical strands of DNA, resulting in exchange of corresponding stretches of DNA between two sister chromosomes.

name: honey bee larval toxicity test
definition: Procedure in which larvae of the honey bee (Apis mellifera) are exposed to a test chemical in the diet and subsequent mortality is recorded daily up to the \(\pu{72\!\!{-}\!h}\) \(\pu{LD_{50}}\).

name: hormone
definition: Substance formed in one organ or part of the body and carried in the blood to another organ or part where it selectively alters functional activity.

name: Human Genome Project
definition: International research project that started in 1990 with the goal of determining the base-pair sequence of the human genome. The project was declared complete in 2003.

name: hydatidiform mole
definition: Vesicular or polycystic mass resulting from the proliferation of the trophoblast, with hydropic degeneration and avascularity of the chorionic villi.

name: hydranencephaly
definition: Rare condition in which the brain’s cerebral hemispheres are replaced by sacs filled with cerebrospinal fluid.

name: hydrocele
definition: Accumulation of serous fluid in a sacculated cavity; specifically, such an accumulation in the space of the tunica vaginalis testis, or in a separate pocket along the spermatic cord.

name: hydrocephalus
definition: Accumulation of excess cerebrospinal fluid within the ventricles of the brain; head enlargement and brain damage may occur.

name: hydromicrocephaly
definition: Microcephaly with excess cerebrospinal fluid.

name: hydronephrosis
definition: Swelling of the funnel-shaped part of the kidney, where urine is collected to enter the ureter.

name: hydrops
definition: Gross edema of the entire body, with severe anemia, occurring in hemolytic disease of the newborn.

name: hydroureter
definition: Dilation of a ureter with fluid.

name: hygroma
definition: Accumulation of fluid in a sac, cyst, or bursa.

name: hymen
definition: Thin, membranous fold of highly variable appearance that, before its rupture, partly occludes the opening of the vagina.

name: hyoid arch
definition: Second pharyngeal or branchial arch of the developing embryo, from which different tissues around the neck, ear, and face will develop.

name: hypaxial
definition: Ventral to the long axis of the body.

name: hyperextension
definition: Extension of a limb or part of a limb beyond the normal limit.

name: hyperflexion
definition: Flexion of a limb or part of a limb beyond the normal limit.

name: hyperplasia
definition: Abnormal multiplication or increase in the number of normal cells in a tissue or organ.

name: hypertelorism
definition: Abnormally wide space between two organs, especially referring to the eyes.

name: hypertrophy
definition: Enlargement of an organ or tissue as a result of the increase in the size of its cells.

name: hypoblast
definition: Innermost of the three primary germ layers, adjacent to the blastocyst cavity, that develops into the endoderm.

name: hypogonadism
definition: Inadequate functioning of the testes or ovaries as manifested by deficiencies in gametogenesis or in secretion of gonadal hormones.

name: hypoplasia
definition: Underdevelopment or atrophy of a tissue or organ.

name: hypospadias
definition: Birth defect in which the urethra opens on the underside of the penis, or into the vagina.

name: hypothalamus
definition: Region at the base of the brain containing specialized nerve cells that help activate, control, and integrate peripheral autonomic mechanisms, endocrine activities, and some somatic functions such as body temperature, sleep, and appetite.

name: hypoxia
definition: Abnormally low dioxygen content or tension. Deficiency of dioxygen in the inspired air, in blood, or in tissues, short of anoxia.

name: ichthyosis
definition: Congenital disorder of keratinization, characterized by dryness and scaling of the skin, often associated with other defects and with abnormalities of lipid metabolism.

name: identical twins
definition: Twins resulting from one zygote that, at an early stage of embryonic development, separated into two independently growing cell aggregations giving rise to two individuals of the same sex and identical genetic constitution.

name: ileocecal
definition: Relating to the ileum and the cecum.

name: ileum
definition: Third portion of the small intestine, between the jejunum and the cecum.

name: iliac artery
definition: Main artery of the pelvis.

name: imperforate anus
definition: Congenital absence of an anal opening due to the persistence of epithelial plug (persistence of the anal membrane) or to complete absence of the anal canal.

name: implantation
definition: Embedding of the early embryo in the lining of the uterus.

name: imposex
definition: Pseudohermaphroditic condition in female gastropods (snails) manifested by the development (imposition) of male characteristics such as a penis or vas deferens.

name: imprinting
definition: Differential expression of a gene, depending on whether it was transmitted through the sperm or the egg.

name: inbred strain
definition: Strain of an animal that has been inbred by brother-sister matings for more than \(\pu{20}\) generations, and consequently all the individuals of the strain are more than \(\pu{98\%}\) genetically identical.

name: female fertility index
definition: In rodents, number of pregnant females divided by the number of females mated, multiplied by 100.

name: gestation index
definition: In rodents, number of females with live born offspring divided by number of females with evidence of pregnancy, multiplied by \(\pu{100}\).

name: male fertility index
definition: In rodents, number of males impregnating females divided by number of males mated, multiplied by \(\pu{100}\).

name: tubular fertility index
definition: Percentage of seminiferous tubules containing identifiable spermatogonia.

name: induced pluripotent stem cell
definition: Pluripotent stem cell that is generated from an adult cell by genetic reprogramming.

name: infertility
definition: Persistent inability of either a male or a female to achieve conception or to produce offspring.

name: infundibulum
definition: Anatomical funnel-shaped opening, often referring to the hollow stalk that connects the hypothalamus and the posterior pituitary gland, or to the portion of the Fallopian tube that receives the ovum.

name: inguinal canal
definition: Passage in the lower anterior abdominal wall, which in men conveys the spermatic cord and in women the round ligament of the uterus.

name: inhibin
definition: Any of a group of peptide hormones secreted by the follicular granulosa cells of the ovary and the Sertoli cells of the testis, inhibiting follicle-stimulating hormone secretion by the anterior pituitary.

name: iniencephaly
definition: Malformation producing a cranial defect at the occiput, with the brain exposed, often combined with a cervical rachischisis and retroflexion.

name: iniopagus
definition: Twins conjoined at the occiput.

name: insemination
definition: Delivery of sperm into the female reproductive system for the purpose or with the result of causing pregnancy.

name: integrin
definition: Any of a family of cell membrane glycoproteins that mediate cell-to-cell and cell-to-extracellular matrix interactions.

name: intermediate filament
definition: Any of a group of fibrous proteins (including keratin fibres, neurofilaments, desmin, and vimentin) that make up part of the cytoskeleton of most eukaryotic cells; so named because, at about \(\pu{10 nm}\) diameter, they are intermediate in thickness between actin filaments and microtubules.

name: intersexuality
definition: Condition of having both male and female characteristics: thus, the state of being intermediate between the sexes.

name: intracytoplasmic sperm injection
definition: Infertility treatment in which the sperm is injected through the membrane of the egg into its cytoplasm.

name: intramembrous ossification
definition: Creation of bone tissue during fetal development of jawed vertebrates, as well as during the healing of bone fractures; the tissue forms from mesenchymal stem cells residing in an extracellular matrix devoid of collagen.

name: intrauterine
definition: Within the uterus.

name: intrauterine growth restriction
definition: Subnormal, poor growth of the fetus.

name: intrinsic pathway
definition: Apoptotic pathway of cell death initiated from within the cell by signals initiated by mitochondrial damage and (or) DNA damage, a defective cell cycle, detachment from the extracellular matrix, hypoxia, loss of cell survival factors, or other types of severe cell stress; characterized by the activation of caspase 9.

name: chromosomal inversion
definition: Rearrangement of a chromosome in which, after breakage at two points, a segment is reversed, resulting in a change in sequence of nucleotides.

name: in vitro fertilization
definition: Fertilization outside the body, used as a treatment for infertility.

name: ischemia
definition: Local deficiency of blood supply, and hence of dioxygen, to an organ or tissue, caused by constriction or obstruction of the blood vessels.

name: isotretinoin
definition: Vitamin A-like medication (13-cis retinoic acid) used, among other things, for acne treatment.

name: jejunum
definition: Second part of the small intestine between the duodenum and ileum.

name: karyolysis
definition: Dissolution of a cell nucleus, especially during mitosis and meiosis but also following necrosis.

name: karyorrhexis
definition: Irreversible fragmentation of the nucleus of a dying cell following karyolysis, whereby its chromatin is distributed irregularly throughout the cytoplasm.

name: karyotype
definition: Characterization of the number, form, and size of the chromosomes of an individual or a species. Photomicrograph of an individual’s chromosomes, arranged according to a standard classification for the species.

name: keratin
definition: Fibrous protein forming the main structural constituent of hair, feathers, hoofs, claws, horns, etc.

name: keratinization
definition: Replacement of the outer epithelial layer of cells, especially in skin, with keratin-rich structures.

name: ketoacidosis
definition: Acidosis, as in diabetes, pregnancy, or starvation, accompanied by the accumulation of ketone bodies in body tissues and fluids.

name: ketone body
definition: Ketone that is an intermediate product of the breakdown of fats in the body; any of three compounds, acetoacetic acid, acetone, and (or) \(\upbeta\)-hydroxybutanoic acid, found in excess in blood and urine of persons with metabolic disorders.

name: Klinefelter syndrome
definition: Syndrome in males resulting from a genetic defect in which an extra female X chromosome (thus an XXY genotype) is present in a male, characterized by small testes, long legs, enlarged breasts, reduced sperm production, and mental retardation.

name: knockout mutation
definition: Mutation that leads to the loss of function of a particular gene.

name: kyphosis
definition: Rearward curvature or convexity of the spine in excess of normal, resulting in a protuberant upper back.

name: labor
definition: Physical efforts of expulsion of the fetus and the placenta from the uterus during birth.

name: lactation
definition: Secretion of milk from the mammary gland, usually to feed the infant during the neonatal period.

name: lactation period
definition: Time following pregnancy during which the mammary glands secrete milk.

name: lamina propria
definition: Layer of connective tissue, underlying the epithelium of a mucus membrane, containing capillaries and lymphatic vessels, as well as fibroblasts and cells of the immune system.

name: larynx
definition: Part of the respiratory tract between the pharynx and the trachea, having walls of cartilage and muscle and containing the vocal cords.

name: leprosy
definition: Disease caused by infection with the bacterium Mycobacterium leprae, often affecting the skin and nerves and causing body parts to become deformed.

name: leptocephaly
definition: Malformation characterized by an abnormally tall, narrow cranium.

name: leptodactyly
definition: Abnormally slender digits.

name: leucism
definition: Lack of pigmentation in the skin, hair, or feathers as a result of a failure of pigment cells to develop, or to migrate to those locations from their origin in the neural crest, in the embryo.

name: leukopenia
definition: Abnormally low concentration of white cells (leukocytes) in the blood.

name: levocardia
definition: Normal position of the heart in the left hemithorax with the apex pointed to the left, and transposition of other viscera.

name: Leydig cell
definition: Cell in the testis that produces androgens, mainly testosterone, in the presence of luteinizing hormone.

name: ligamentum arteriosum
definition: Fibrous remnant of the ductus arteriosis linking the aortic arch and the top of the left pulmonary artery.

name: limb bud
definition: Embryonic outgrowth of mesoderm covered in ectoderm that will give rise to one of the forelimbs or hindlimbs.

name: linkage analysis
definition: Technique that studies patterns of heredity in high-risk families, in order to locate a disease-causing gene mutation by identifying co-inherited traits, usually by producing a LOD score.

name: linkage disequilibrium
definition: Occurrence in members of a population of combinations of linked genes in non-random proportions, implying that the genes are close enough together on a chromosome to make it unlikely that they will be separated by recombination (see homologous recombination) during meiosis.

name: lipidosis
definition: Disorder of fat metabolism characterized by the accumulation of abnormal levels of certain lipids in the body.

name: litter
definition: Multiple offspring produced by a mammal from one pregnancy.

name: locus
definition: Specific location of a gene or DNA sequence on a chromosome.

name: LOD score
definition: Ratio of the likelihood of two or more loci remaining together when chromosomes recombine (true linkage) to the likelihood of this occurring by chance alone.

name: lordosis
definition: Forward (ventral) curvature of the spine in the lumbar and cervical regions.

name: lumbar puncture
definition: Piercing into the subarachnoid space of the lumbar region in order to obtain spinal fluid for diagnostic purposes or to inject a drug.

name: luteal phase
definition: Phase of the human menstrual cycle, usually lasting \(\pu{14 days}\), beginning with formation of the corpus luteum and ending, in the absence of fertilization, with the onset of menstruation.

name: luteinizing hormone
definition: Hormone made by the pituitary gland that acts on the ovary to control egg maturation and to trigger ovulation. The same hormone acts in the testes to trigger production of testosterone.

name: lymphatic
definition: Relating to lymph or its secretion.

name: lymphoid
definition: Relating to or denoting tissue responsible for producing lymphocytes and antibodies.

name: Lyon hypothesis
definition: Hypothesis (named after Mary Lyon) that random inactivation of all but one X chromosome occurs in each female mammalian cell in early development, thus explaining why the effect of the X chromosome on phenotype is the same in males with one copy as in females with two copies.

name: lysosomal storage disease
definition: One of a group of rare inherited metabolic disorders resulting from a defect in lysosomal function, commonly a deficiency of enzymes required for the metabolism of lipids, glycoproteins, or mucopolysaccharides, resulting in their accumulation in the cell.

name: macrocephaly
definition: Congenital disorder characterized by an abnormally large head and (or) brain.

name: macroglossia
definition: Congenital disorder characterized by an abnormally enlarged tongue.

name: macrognathia
definition: Congenital disorder characterized by enlargement or elongation of the jaw.

name: macromelia
definition: Congenital disorder characterized by an abnormally large limb or limbs.

name: macrosomia
definition: Congenital disorder characterized by an abnormally large body or body part.

name: macrostomia
definition: Congenital disorder characterized by an abnormally large size of the mouth.

name: malformation
definition: Structural defect as a result of abnormal development.

name: malignant
definition: Occurring in a severe form, tending to become progressively worse, resistant to treatment, and likely to result in death. In cancer, cells showing both uncontrolled growth and a tendency to invade and destroy other tissues.

name: mammary gland
definition: Milk-producing organ in female mammals.

name: Marfan syndrome
definition: Congenital connective tissue disorder associated with mutation of the fibrillin-1 gene FBN1.

name: masculinization
definition: Development of male characteristics, such as facial hair, either as part of normal male maturation, or, pathologically, by people of either sex as a result of hormonal imbalance.

name: maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein
definition: Protein made in the fetus that normally leaks, in small amounts, into the mother’s circulation.

name: maxillary
definition: Relating to the maxilla (upper jaw).

name: Meckel diverticulum
definition: Congenital pouch in the ileum resulting from incomplete closure of the yolk sac.

name: meconium
definition: First intestinal discharges of the newborn infant, greenish in color and consisting of epithelial cells, mucus, and bile.

name: median teratogenic concentration
definition: Median concentration resulting in developmental malformations for \(\pu{50\%}\) of exposed test animals within a predetermined time, e.g., \(\pu{96 h}\).

name: mediastinum
definition: Region in the middle of the thorax between the two lungs, containing the regional vessels, trachea, esophagus, bronchi, lymph nodes, and heart.

name: medulla
definition: [medulla oblongata] Lower part of the brain stem continuous with the spinal cord, containing neural centers regulating the autonomic functions of breathing, heart rate, and blood pressure. Middle (central) part of an organ, as in adrenal medulla, renal medulla, or the medulla of a lymph node.

name: megacolon
definition: Condition of extreme dilation of the colon that can be congenital (as in Hirschsprung disease) or acquired (as when children refuse to defecate).

name: megadactyly
definition: Disorder characterized by an abnormally large fingers and (or) toes.

name: menarche
definition: First menstrual cycle of a woman.

name: Mendelian gene
definition: Gene located in a chromosome that obeys the laws of Mendelian inheritance.

name: Mendelian inheritance
definition: Inheritance in which stable and indivisible characteristics are controlled entirely or overwhelmingly by a single genetic locus and transmitted over many generations.

name: Mendelian trait
definition: Phenotype that shows a pattern of Mendelian inheritance.

name: meninx
definition: Any of the three membranes (the dura mater, arachnoid, and pia mater) that line the skull and vertebral canal and enclose the brain and spinal cord.

name: meningocele
definition: Herniation of the membranes of the brain or spinal cord (see meninx) through a defect in the cranium or spinal column.

name: meningomyelocele
definition: Birth defect following failure of the neural tube to close, resulting in protrusion of a sac of nerve tissue and its covering membranes.

name: menopause
definition: Cessation of reproductive capability in a woman, marked by declining ovarian function and an end to menses.

name: menstrual cycle
definition: The period, normally lasting \(\pu{28 days}\) in the human female, during which an ovum matures, is ovulated, and enters the uterus through the Fallopian tubes. If fertilization occurs, the cycle is interrupted by pregnancy; otherwise, the cycle ends with menstruation.

name: menstruation
definition: Cyclic endometrial shedding and discharge of a bloody fluid from the uterus during the menstrual cycle.

name: meromelia
definition: Congenital absence of a part of a limb, resulting in a shrunken and deformed extremity.

name: mesectoderm
definition: Embryonic migratory cells derived from the neural crest of the head that contribute to the formation of the meninges (see meninx) and become pigment cells.

name: mesencephalon
definition: Part of the vertebrate brain that develops from the middle section of the embryonic neural tube.

name: mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition
definition: Process in which motile mesenchymal cells undergo a development to planar, polarized fixed cells, forming epithelia.

name: mesenchyme
definition: Meshwork of embryonic connective tissue in the mesoderm, from which are formed the bone, muscular, and connective tissues of the body and also the urogenital system, blood vessels, and lymph vessels.

name: mesentery
definition: Membranous sheet attaching various organs to the body wall, especially the peritoneal fold attaching the intestine to the dorsal body wall.

name: mesoderm
definition: Middle layer of cells in the embryo, lying between the ectoderm and the endoderm. It includes the following tissues: Lateral mesoderm: peripheral portion of intraembryonic mesoderm. Intermediate mesoderm: origin of the nephrogenic cord. Parietal (somatic) mesoderm: cell source for the formation of the lateral and ventral body wall. Visceral (branchial, pharyngeal, splanchnic) mesoderm: inner layer of lateral mesoderm that, with the endoderm, provides the cells from which the gut and lungs and their coverings arise.

name: mesogastrium
definition: Part of the embryonic mesentery that is attached to the early stomach.

name: mesonephric duct
definition: Embryonic duct of the mesonephros, which in the male becomes the vas deferens and in the female becomes vestigial.

name: mesonephros
definition: Middle part of the embryonic kidney in vertebrates, becoming the adult kidney in fishes and amphibians and the epididymis in reptiles, birds, and mammals.

name: mesothelium
definition: Single layer of flattened cells forming an epithelium that lines serous cavities such as the peritoneum, pleura, and pericardium.

name: metabologen
definition: Morphogen, including bone morphogenetic protein, that affects metabolism and homeostasis.

name: metallothionein
definition: One of a family of low-molecular mass proteins that binds metals such as zinc, copper, cadmium and mercury.

name: metanephros
definition: Primordium of the permanent kidney, developing later than, and caudal to, the mesonephros.

name: metaphase
definition: Stage of mitosis or meiosis in which the chromosomes become aligned on the equatorial plate of the cell, separating the centromeres.

name: metaplasia
definition: Abnormal transformation of an adult, fully differentiated tissue of one kind into a differentiated tissue of another kind.

name: methylation
definition: Attachment of a methyl group to a molecule.

name: microcephaly
definition: Congenital occurrence of an abnormally small head.

name: microcheiria
definition: Congenital occurrence of abnormally small hands.

name: microglossia
definition: Congenital occurrence of an abnormally small tongue.

name: micrognathia
definition: Congenital occurrence of abnormally small jaws, especially effecting the mandible.

name: micromass culture
definition: Laboratory technique in which dispersed cells from an embryonic organ or tissue, such as the brain, limb bud, or cartilage, are allowed to reaggregate in culture.

name: micronucleus test
definition: Test for mutagenicity in which animals are treated with a test agent, after which time the frequency of micronucleated cells is determined. Note: If a test group shows significantly increased levels of micronucleated cells compared to a control group, the chemical is considered capable of inducing chromosomal damage. Procedure to detect clastogenic or aneugenic agents by microscopic examination of chromosomes. Note: The test can be performed in vivo in rodents, or in cell culture (in vitro mammalian cell micronucleus test).

name: microphallus
definition: Abnormally small penis.

name: microphthalmia
definition: Congenital occurrence of abnormally small eyeballs.

name: microsatellite
definition: Non-coding segment of DNA consisting of short nucleotide sequences (\(\pu{2\!{-}\! 6}\) base pairs), typically occurring in \(\pu{10\!{-}\! 100}\) consecutive (tandem) repeats.

name: microstomia
definition: Congenital occurrence of an abnormally small opening of the mouth.

name: midgut
definition: Middle section of the digestive tract in a vertebrate embryo, from which the ileum, jejunum, and portions of the duodenum and colon develop.

name: Minamata disease
definition: Neurological disease caused by methylmercury, first seen in subjects ingesting contaminated fish from Minamata Bay in Japan.

name: minisatellite
definition: Non-coding segment of DNA, found throughout the genome, usually near the ends of chromosomes, that consists of tandem repeats of sequences of about \(\pu{10\!{-}\! 100}\) base pairs.

name: miscarriage
definition: Lay term for spontaneous abortion.

name: molecular epidemiology
definition: Use in epidemiological studies of techniques of molecular biology, such as DNA profiling and genetic analysis, with the aim of detecting genetic patterns characteristic of susceptible populations or of groups at risk of disease.

name: monophthalmos
definition: Congenital absence of one eye.

name: monosomy
definition: Disorder in which body cells have only one pair instead of the normal two pairs of a particular chromosome.

name: morphogen
definition: Any of various signalling factors in embryonic tissue that influences the movement and organization of cells during morphogenesis by forming a concentration gradient.

name: morphogenesis
definition: Shaping of an organism during embryological development by differentiation of cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems, according to the genetic program of the organism, and influenced by morphogens and environmental conditions.

name: morphological
definition: Pertaining to structure or form.

name: morula
definition: Early multi-celled stage of the embryo from which the blastocyst is formed.

name: mosaicism
definition: Condition in which an individual or an organism that develops from a single zygote has two or more cell populations that differ in genetic constitution.

name: sperm motility
definition: Energy-dependent forward movement of the sperm, allowing it to reach and penetrate the egg.

name: mucous membrane
definition: Layer of epithelial tissue with a thin underlying layer of connective tissue (the lamina propria) that lines many body cavities, including the gut, respiratory passages, and tubular organs; it secretes, and is covered in, mucus.

name: mucus
definition: Slippery viscous fluid, consisting largely of water and glycoproteins, secreted by mucous membranes.

name: multicotyledonary placentation
definition: Formation of a placenta with many lobes.

name: multifactorial inheritance
definition: Transmission from parents to offspring of a trait that is determined by multiple genetic and environmental factors, each with a small effect.

name: multigenerational study
definition: Animal test of reproductive toxicity in which two to three generations of the test organism are exposed to the substance being assessed. Animal test of reproductive toxicity in which only one generation is exposed and effects on subsequent generations are assessed.

name: mycoplasma
definition: Very small infectious microorganism, related to bacteria, but without a cell wall.

name: myelencephalon
definition: Part of the brain in the embryo that gives rise to the medulla oblongata.

name: myelination
definition: The acquisition, development, or formation of a myelin sheath around a nerve fiber.

name: myeloblast
definition: Immature bone marrow cell that is a precursor of the granulocyte series.

name: myelotoxic
definition: Harming bone marrow or any of its components.

name: myoblast
definition: Mononucleate cell that is committed to differentiate into muscle.

name: myocarditis
definition: Inflammation of the heart muscle.

name: myocardium
definition: Muscle of the heart.

name: myometrium
definition: Muscular wall of the uterus.

name: myositis
definition: Inflammation of muscle.

name: myotome
definition: In the embryo, that part of a somite that develops into skeletal muscle.

name: nasal
definition: Relating to the nose.

name: natality
definition: Rate of birth, the number of newborn individuals per unit time.

name: necropsy
definition: Postmortem examination of the organs and body tissue of a non-human animal to determine cause of death or pathological condition.

name: neonate
definition: Newborn animal or human infant during the first four weeks of postnatal life.

name: neoplasm
definition: New and abnormal formation of tissue as a consequence of growth by cell proliferation, which may continue after the initial stimulus that initiated the proliferation has ceased, and which may develop into a tumor.

name: neural
definition: Pertaining to a nerve or to the nervous system. Pertaining to the dorsal side of the vertebral bodies or to their precursors.

name: neural arch
definition: Dorsal bony covering of the spinal cord. Cartilaginous structures surrounding the embryonicspinal cord.

name: neural crest
definition: Band of cells on either side of the neural tube.

name: neural plate
definition: Area in the middle of the early embryo that rolls up to form the neural tube.

name: neural tube
definition: Embryonic tubular structure that becomes the brain and spinal cord.

name: neural tube defect
definition: Failure of the neural tube to close properly during gastrulation.

name: neurobehavioral
definition: Pertaining to the function of the nervous system as it relates to behavior.

name: neuroblast
definition: Cell derived from neural stem cell that will differentiate into a neuron.

name: neuroblastoma
definition: Malignant neoplasm consisting of poorly differentiated embryonic nerve cells (neuroblasts).

name: neuroectoderm
definition: Central region of the early embryonic ectoderm that will give rise to the brain and spinal cord, together with the neural crest cells that will form the peripheral nervous system.

name: neuroendocrine system
definition: Combined cooperating network of the nervous system and hormonal systems.

name: neuroendocrine
definition: Pertaining to the nervous and endocrine systems in anatomical or functional relationship.

name: neurohypophysis
definition: Posterior lobe of the pituitary gland, involved in the storage and secretion of oxytocin and vasopressin.

name: neuron
definition: Nerve cell.

name: neuropore
definition: Opening at either the cranial (caudal) or anterior (rostral) end of the neural tube before it completes closure in the early embryonic stage.

name: neurotrophin
definition: One of several protein growth factors that regulates development, maintenance, and function of the vertebrate nervous system.

name: neurulation
definition: Formation of the embryonic neural plate and its rolling up into the neural tube.

name: nipple
definition: Projection on the apex of the breast through which the ducts of the milk-producing glands open.

name: nodal
definition: Growth factor of the transforming growth factor \(\upbeta\) (TGF-\(\upbeta\)) superfamily, coded by a gene designated NODAL, that plays crucial roles in embryogenesis, particularly in signalling from the primitive streak to the mesoderm to establish left-right asymmetry as well as aspects of stem cell differentiation.

name: noggin
definition: Signaling protein released by the notochord, important in somite patterning and nervous system development.

name: nondisjunction
definition: Failure of chromosomes to separate during meiosis, resulting in an uneven distribution of chromosomes in the two gametes (\(\pu{24}\) and \(\pu{22}\) in humans).

name: noradrenaline
definition: Catecholamine hormone acting as a postganglionic adrenergic mediator at $\ce{\upalpha\!\mbox{-}}$ and $\ce{\upbeta\!\mbox{-}adrenergic}$ receptors.

name: notochord
definition: Rod-shaped structure of cells derived from mesoderm, lying ventral to the neural tube and defining the primitive axis of the embryo.

name: nuclear spindle
definition: Structure, formed from microtubules, that draws the newly duplicated chromosomes apart during mitosis and meiosis.

name: nuclear type I receptor
definition: Steroid hormone receptor, found in the cytosol, that upon ligand binding translocates into the nucleus and interacts with DNA as a homodimer to drive specific gene transcription.

name: nuclear type II receptor
definition: Steroid hormone receptor, found in the nucleus, that upon ligand binding interacts with DNA as a heterodimer (usually with the retinoid X receptor, RXR) to drive specific gene transcription.

name: nulligravida
definition: Never having been pregnant.

name: nulliparous
definition: Never having given birth to a live infant.

name: occiput
definition: Back part of the head or skull.

name: odontoblast
definition: Dentin-forming cell of the pulp cavity of a tooth, arising from the mesenchyme of the neural crest.

name: offspring
definition: Child or children of a person, or the young of an animal, in relation to the parent(s).

name: oligodactyly
definition: Congenital occurrence of fewer than the usual number of digits, resulting in humans having fewer than five fingers or toes on a hand or foot.

name: oligodontia
definition: Congenital absence of some of the teeth.

name: oligomenomenorrhea
definition: Infrequent or scanty menstruation.

name: oligospermia
definition: Subnormal concentration of sperm in the male ejaculate (see ejaculation).

name: omentum
definition: Fold of peritoneal membrane passing between the stomach and another abdominal organ.

name: greater omentum
definition: Omentum passing from the greater curvature of the stomach in front of the small intestine, folding back on itself to fuse into four layers of peritoneal membrane, and ascending to the transverse colon.

name: lesser omentum
definition: Double-layer of peritoneal membrane (omentum) passing between the lesser curvature of the stomach and the duodenum.

name: omphalocele
definition: Congenital herniation of abdominal viscera into the base of the umbilical cord.

name: omphalosite
definition: Lesser developed of two monozygotic twins that failed to separate completely during embryogenesis.

name: one-generation reprotox study
definition: Procedure in which male rodents are dosed with a test substance for at least one spermatogenic cycle, and females for two estrous cycles, and then further exposed during mating, pregnancy, and nursing; adverse effects on reproduction, parturition, lactation and postnatal growth are studied.

name: oocyte
definition: Immature precursor of the ovum resident in the ovary.

name: primary oocyte
definition: Oocyte during growth phase before completion of the first meiotic division.

name: secondary oocyte
definition: Oocyte in which the first meiotic division to a haploid cell has been completed.

name: oogenesis
definition: Process of formation and development of an ovum.

name: oogonium
definition: Primitive germ cell that proliferates by mitosis and develops into a primary oocyte prior to birth.

name: optic
definition: Relating to the eye or vision.

name: orbit
definition: Cavity in the skull of a vertebrate that contains the eye.

name: organ of Corti
definition: Specialized collection of epithelial hair cells in the inner ear, involved in hearing.

name: organogenesis
definition: Formation and development of organs.

name: orofacial cleft
definition: Failure of the lip or palate to fuse properly.

name: osteoclast
definition: Large multinucleate cell that resorbs bone, allowing for the deposition of new bone.

name: osteogenesis
definition: Laying down of new bone tissue.

name: ostium
definition: Opening into a vessel or cavity of the body.

name: otic
definition: Pertaining to, or located near the ear.

name: otocephaly
definition: Congenital anomaly characterized by the absence or extreme underdevelopment of the lower jaw, producing closeness of the ears below the face.

name: ovarian cycle
definition: Sequence of events occurring in the ovary involved in ovulation.

name: ovarian follicle
definition: Cavity in the ovary containing a maturing ovum, at any stage of development, surrounded by its encasing cells.

name: ovary
definition: One of the paired female reproductive glands containing the ova (see ovum).

name: ovotestis
definition: Abnormal gonad in which both ovarian and testicular tissues are present, and thus a form of hermaphroditism.

name: ovulation
definition: Release of a mature ovum from the ovary into the Fallopian tube.

name: ovum
definition: Mature female sex cell, capable of undergoing fertilization.

name: oxytocin
definition: Peptide hormone secreted by the neurohypophysis that stimulates contraction of the myometrium during labor and secretion of milk during lactation.

name: palate
definition: Roof of the mouth, separating the oral and nasal cavities.

name: palatine raphe
definition: Medial central ridge of the palate.

name: Papanicolaou smear
definition: Examination by light microscopy of a sample of cells scraped from the uterine cervix, used to screen for cervical cancer.

name: paracrine
definition: Type of signaling in which a cell secretes into the intercellular space a molecular messenger that diffuses and binds to receptors on nearby target cells, producing a signal in those cells.

name: parafollicular cell
definition: Neuroendocrine cell that migrates into the thyroid gland during embryonic development and secretes the hormone calcitonin.

name: paramesonephric duct
definition: One of two paired embryonic ducts of mesodermal origin that will become the Fallopian tubes, uterus, cervix and upper part of the vagina in the female, and will regress in the male.

name: parametrium
definition: Connective tissue of the floor of the female pelvis that lies in front of the uterine cervix and separates it from the bladder.

name: parasitic twin
definition: Smaller of unequal conjoined twins.

name: paraxial mesoderm
definition: Area of mesoderm in the embryo that forms during neurulation, lies along both sides of the neural tube, and gives rise to the somites.

name: parenchymal cell
definition: Distinguishing or specific type of cell of an organ or gland, contained in, or supported by, the connective tissue framework provided by the stromal cells.

name: parietal
definition: Relating to or denoting the wall of the body or of a body cavity or hollow structure.

name: gastric parietal cell
definition: Acid-producing cell in the stomach.

name: parthenogenesis
definition: Type of nonsexual reproduction in which an unfertilized ovum develops into an embryo.

name: parturition
definition: Process of giving birth by a maternal organism.

name: patent ductus arteriosus
definition: Congenital disorder wherein the ductus arteriosis fails to close after birth.

name: pelvic kidney
definition: Congenital abnormality in which a kidney develops and remains in the pelvic area.

name: pericardium
definition: Serous membranous sac that surrounds the heart, consisting of an inner visceral layer (the epicardium), and an outer parietal pericardium that is attached to the sternum and diaphragm.

name: perinatal
definition: Relating to the period from shortly before to shortly after birth, in humans usually from the 20th to the 29th week of gestation to one to four weeks after birth.

name: perineum
definition: Muscular structure of the lower pelvis, between the legs and extending from the anus to the pubic symphysis, or alternatively including the anus and vagina in the female and the region from the anus to the base of the scrotum in the male.

name: peritoneal cavity
definition: Potential space between the two layers (visceral and parietal) of the peritoneum.

name: peritoneum
definition: Thin double layer of mesothelium and irregular connective tissue that lines the abdominal cavity and covers most of the abdominal organs.

name: phage display
definition: Method that enables the presentation of large peptide libraries on the surface of phage particles, from which proteins with desired functional properties can be selected rapidly.

name: pharyngeal groove
definition: One of several paired grooves in the embryonic endoderm, lateral to the corresponding pharyngeal pouch in the ectoderm.

name: pharyngeal pouch
definition: One of several paired evaginations in the embryonic endoderm that develop into epithelial tissues and organs such as the thymus and thyroid gland.

name: pharynx
definition: Part of the digestive tube lying between the esophagus (below) and the mouth and nasal cavity (above and anterior).

name: phenylketonuria
