name: microextraction (technique)
definition: Extraction technique in which the volume (mass) of the extraction phase (liquid or solid) is substantially smaller than the sample volume (mass).

name: microextraction (packed sorbent)
definition: Solid-phase extraction using a syringe with a short sorbent bed located between the plunger and the needle.

name: acclimation
definition: Adjustment, physiologically and (or) behaviorally, of an organism to its environment or circumstances, e.g., thermoregulation, psychological adjustment.

name: acetylcholine
definition: Substance that functions as a neurotransmitter between nerve cells and between nerves and muscles.

name: acetylcholinesterase
definition: Enzyme that hydrolyzes acetylcholine.

name: acetylcholine receptor
definition: Integral membrane protein that allows the cell to respond to the binding of acetylcholine.

name: acoustic neuroma
definition: Non-malignant intracranial tumor of the eighth cranial nerve.

name: acroparesthesia
definition: Abnormal feeling of numbness, tingling, or burning of the skin, typically in the extremities.

name: action potential
definition: Brief, spike-like depolarization associated with the passage of an impulse without decrement along the membrane of a muscle cell or nerve cell.

name: active avoidance test
definition: Fear-motivated associative avoidance test based on presentation of an adverse stimulus (e.g., an electric current) as a source of discomfort, to create an environment from which the animal or subject would prefer to escape.

name: addiction
definition: Compulsive, uncontrolled reward-seeking behavior, especially referring to substance use.

name: adenoma
definition: Benign tumor arising from epithelial cells in glandular tissue.

name: adenosine receptor
definition: Any of four types of purinergic receptors that respond to the nucleoside, adenosine, two of which are involved in release of the neurotransmitters, dopamine and glutamate.

name: adrenalin
definition: Catecholamine hormone secreted by the adrenal glands that increases heart rate, breathing rate, blood pressure, and carbohydrate metabolism.

name: adrenergic
definition: Relating to or denoting secretion of and (or) response to adrenalin, noradrenalin or related substances; in particular referring to sympathetic nerve fibers. Relating to or denoting an agent that mimics the activity of adrenalin, noradrenalin or related substances.

name: α-adrenergic receptor
definition: Class of adrenergicreceptor mainly functioning in vasoconstriction and modulation of glandular secretions.

name: β-adrenergic receptor
definition: Member of a class of G protein-coupled receptors that are targets of the catecholamines, especially adrenalin, noradrenalin, and related substances.

name: afferent
definition: Inflowing. Of nerves, those that conduct impulses toward the central nervous system.

name: agnosia
definition: Impaired ability to recognize or comprehend the meaning of various sensations, not attributable to faulty sensory input or general intellect.

name: alpha-synuclein
definition: Protein abundant in the human brain, thought to regulate the release of dopamine.

name: Alzheimer disease
definition: Common and progressive neurodegenerative disease leading to loss of memory, orientation, and judgment.

name: γ-aminobutyric acid
definition: Major neurotransmitter at inhibitory synapses in the central nervous system of mammals.

name: γ-aminobutyric acid receptor
definition: Transmembrane receptor protein that binds and responds to the inhibitory neurotransmitter $\ce{\upgamma\!\mbox{-}aminobutyric acid}$.

name: 2-amino-3-(3-hydroxy-5-methyl-1,2-oxazol-4-yl)propanoic acid receptor
definition: Glutamate receptor in the central nervous system activated by the synthetic glutamate analog, AMPA.

name: amnesia
definition: Partial or total, transient or permanent loss of memory.

name: amnesic shellfish poisoning
definition: Human illness caused by consumption of the marine toxin domoic acid that may lead to dizziness, confusion, motor weakness and seizures, with permanent cognitive impairment and short term memory loss.

name: amygdala
definition: Brain nucleus located in the median temporal lobe that is part of the limbic system and plays an important role in emotional responses.

name: β-amyloid
definition: Extracellular aggregate of misfolded fibrous proteins, typically with cross-linked $\ce{\upbeta\!\mbox{-}sheet}$ structure.

name: amyloid plaque
definition: Structure representing extracellular deposition of $\ce{\upbeta\!\mbox{-}amyloid protein}$ in the gray matter of the brain that occurs with aging and in increased amount in Alzheimer disease.

name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
definition: Debilitating degenerative disease of the motor neurons characterized by progressive muscle weakness, muscle atrophy and fasciculations, muscle spasticity, difficulty speaking (dysarthria), difficulty swallowing (dysphagia), and difficulty breathing (dyspnea).

name: anaphrodisiac
definition: Anything tending to reduce libido.

name: anesthetic
definition: Substance that reduces the experience of pain with or without loss of consciousness.

name: angiography
definition: Radiography of blood or lymph vessels, following the introduction of a radio-opaque substance.

name: annulus
definition: Tough outer ring of an intervertebral disc.

name: anorexia
definition: Eating disorder characterized by self-imposed food restriction.

name: anorexia nervosa
definition: Eating disorder characterized by obsessive desire to lose weight by reducing food intake or by repeated vomiting.

name: anosmia
definition: Loss of the sense of smell, either total or selective.

name: anticonvulsant
definition: Substance used to prevent or reduce the severity of convulsions.

name: antidepressant
definition: Substance used to alleviate depression.

name: antiemetic
definition: Substance used to prevent nausea and vomiting (emesis).

name: antineuralgic
definition: Substance used to alleviate the pain of neuralgia.

name: antinociception
definition: Blockage of the perception of pain.

name: antipsychotic
definition: Psychoactive substance used to manage psychotic behavior or psychotic ideation.

name: antispasmodic
definition: Substance used to prevent muscle spasms.

name: anxiolytic
definition: Agent that reduces anxiety without causing excessive sedation.

name: aphasia
definition: Difficulty with, or loss of the use of language in reading, writing or speaking owing to specific lesions in the brain.

name: aphonia
definition: Loss of the voice.

name: aphrodisiac
definition: Anything that stimulates libido.

name: apneusis
definition: Abnormal breathing pattern consisting of a pause at full inspiration.

name: apraxia
definition: Neurological condition characterized by loss of the ability to perform skilled or purposeful movement that a person is nevertheless physically able and willing to do.

name: arachnoiditis
definition: Inflammation of the arachnoid membrane, often characterized by perception of burning pain in the legs.

name: arborization
definition: Terminal branching of a neuron into a treelike structure of the dendrites.

name: arrhythmia
definition: Condition in which there is an irregular or abnormal heart beat.

name: arteriolovenular anastomosis
definition: Communication in which blood is shunted from arterioles to venules without passing through capillaries.

name: arteriovenous
definition: Relating to both arteries and veins.

name: arteriovenous anastomosis
definition: Communication between an artery and a vein by collateral channels.

name: arteriovenous fistula
definition: Abnormal communication between an artery and a vein.

name: arteriovenous malformation
definition: Web of blood vessels with one or more abnormal communications between arteries and veins that bypass the capillary system.

name: associative avoidance test
definition: Avoidance test in which the test animal has learned to develop an association between the stimulus and the delivery of an aversive event.

name: associative learning
definition: Process in which a new behavior arises as a consequence of association with a particular stimulus, sometimes restricted to learning through classical conditioning.

name: astrocyte
definition: Glial cell of ectodermal origin in the central nervous system, characterized by filamentous protoplasmic extensions.

name: reactive astrocyte
definition: Astrocyte that, after injury or excessive neural activity, undergoes morphological (including extension of pseudopodia) and biochemical (notably increased synthesis of glial fibrillary acidic protein) changes and participates in astrocytic scar formation.

name: astrocytic scar
definition: Clustering of reactive astrocytes separating a localized brain injury from surrounding uninjured tissue.

name: astrocytoma
definition: Tumor within the substance of the brain or spinal cord made up of astrocytes.

name: astrogliosis
definition: Localized site of reactive astrocytes, distinct from an astrocytic scar.

name: ataxia
definition: Loss of muscular coordination (see motor coordination) resulting in abnormal clumsiness.

name: athetosis
definition: Condition in which inappropriate muscle contraction causes involuntary writhing movements.

name: atony
definition: Lacking muscular tone.

name: attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
definition: Neuropsychiatric disorder of childhood characterized by decreased attention span, impulsiveness and hyperactivity.

name: aura
definition: Constellation of symptoms experienced before a migraine headache or seizure.

name: autism
definition: Neurodevelopmental disorder, present from early childhood, characterized by great difficulty in communicating and forming relationships with other people and in using abstract concepts.

name: autonomic nervous system
definition: Part of the peripheral nervous system controlling the bodily functions that are not consciously directed, e.g., breathing, heart rate, and digestive processes.

name: avoidance test
definition: Associative learning pairing an adverse event with a non-specific stimulus such that the animal learns to respond in a manner to avoid the adverse event.

name: axon
definition: Long thread-like process of a neuron along which impulses are conducted from the cell body to the nerve ending.

name: axonal degeneration
definition: Progressive loss of structure and function of an axon, typically in a peripheral-to-central direction.

name: axonal transport
definition: Movement of organelles and biomolecules to (retrograde) and from (anterograde) a neuron’s cell body, within the cytoplasm of its axon (the axoplasm).

name: axonopathy
definition: Damage (peripheral neuropathy) to multiple nerves in roughly the same areas on both sides of the body, causing weakness, numbness, and paresthesia.

name: bar test
definition: Test for catalepsy in which a mouse is placed on a bar oriented parallel to and approximately \(\pu{2.5 cm}\) off the ground. Typically, if the mouse remains immobile on the bar for more than 20 seconds, it is considered to be cataleptic.

name: Barnes maze
definition: Circular platform equipped with some 20 equidistant holes near the outer rim, one of which is marked by visual cues and is an escape hole for a rodent that is placed near the middle of the platform and subjected to an adverse stimulus, e.g., bright light.

name: Bayley scale
definition: Range of scores on play tasks performed by infants age 0–3 years, intended to assess development of motor, cognitive, and language skills against norms for age-matched normal child development.

name: beading
definition: Focal bead-like swellings in dendrites and axons.

name: beam walking test
definition: Assessment of the ability of an animal to remain upright and to walk on an elevated and relatively narrow beam.

name: Benton test
definition: Procedure in which patterns on cards are memorized by a test subject who then attempts to recognize them on other cards presented subsequently.

name: Biel water maze
definition: A water labyrinth, described by Biel (1940), where rodents are forced to swim until they find a small underwater platform that allows them to escape.

name: bipolar disorder
definition: Psychiatric illness characterized by mood shifts with periods of severe depressive illness and one or more episodes of exaggerated activity levels (manic behavior).

name: β-blocker
definition: Any of a class of drugs that targets the $\ce{\upbeta\!\mbox{-}adrenergic receptor}$, interferes with binding of adrenalin and other related substances to the receptor, and weakens their effects.
synonyms: β-adrenergic antagonist|β-adrenergic blocking agent|β-adrenergic receptor antagonist|β-adrenoreceptor antagonist|β-antagonist

name: blood–brain barrier
definition: Selectively permeable structure that restricts the exit of blood cells and many substances from the brain capillaries into the extracellular space of the brain.

name: blood–cerebrospinal fluid barrier
definition: Functional restriction by cells of the choroid plexus of transit of substances from the cerebrospinal fluid into the extracellular space of the brain.

name: blood–retinal barrier
definition: Functional restriction of transit of substances from the blood to the retina by non-fenestrated endothelial cells with tight junctions.

name: Boston naming test
definition: Procedure in which 60 pictures are shown to a subject who has to name them quickly.

name: brachial plexus
definition: Bundle of nerve fibers that begins in the spine at the base of the neck, travels through the axilla (armpit region), and into the arm.

name: bradycardia
definition: Abnormally slow heart rate.

name: bradykinesia
definition: Abnormally slow body movement.

name: brain
definition: That part of the central nervous system contained within the cranium.

name: brain-derived neurotrophic factor
definition: Protein secreted by the brain that acts on neurons in the central and peripheral nervous systems; a member of the neurotrophin family of growth factors, related to the nerve growth factor (NGF).

name: brain herniation
definition: Movement of part of the brain across structures within the skull such as a shift across such structures as the falx cerebri, the tentorium cerebelli, and even sometimes through the foramen magnum in the base of the skull (through which the spinal cord connects with the brain).

name: brain slice
definition: Slice of brain tissue immersed in artificial cerebrospinal fluid, used in electrophysiology experiments to allow study of a synapse or neural circuit in isolation from the rest of the brain, and in metabolic studies, under controlled physiological conditions.

name: brainstem
definition: Unpaired subdivision of the brain, continuous with the spinal cord, that includes the thalamus, hypothalamus, pons, medulla oblongata, and the mesencephalon.

name: Broca area
definition: Region in the frontal lobe of one of the hemispheres (the speech-dominant hemisphere, usually the left) of the hominid brain that is involved in motor functions of speech production.

name: bruxism
definition: Involuntary habitual grinding of the teeth, frequently during sleep.

name: burr hole surgery
definition: Medical intervention in which a hole is drilled or scraped into the human skull, exposing the dura mater, to gain access during surgery, to relieve intracranial pressure, to evacuate a subdural hematoma, etc.

name: butyrylcholinesterase
definition: Enzyme, found mainly in the liver, that hydrolyzes choline esters; it is non-specific and distinct from acetylcholinesterase.

name: CA1-pyramidal cell
definition: Pyramidal neuron located in the cornu ammonis area 1, in the hippocampus.

name: CA3-pyramidal cell
definition: Pyramidal neuron located in the cornu ammonis area 3, in the hippocampus.

name: Caenorhabditis elegans
definition: Nematode with a well defined small neural network and homologues of human neurotransmitters, used as a model organism for studying normal development as well as neurotoxicity.

name: california verbal learning test
definition: Procedure in which some common words are read aloud and the test subject is asked to recall as many of these as possible.

name: carcinoma
definition: Malignant tumor of an epithelial cell.

name: carotid artery
definition: One of two paired large arteries on either side of the neck that supplies most of the cerebralhemisphere.

name: carpel tunnel syndrome
definition: Median nerve entrapment neuropathy that causes paresthesia, pain, and numbness due to compression of the nerve at the wrist in the carpal tunnel.

name: cassavism
definition: Epidemic paralytic disease, mainly affecting women and children, occurring in remote rural areas of African and Latin American countries, where cassava root is an important food.

name: cauda equina
definition: Bundle of long spinal nerve roots arising from the end of the spinal cord and filling the lower part of the spinal canal (from approximately the thoraco-lumbar junction downwards).

name: caudate nucleus
definition: Crescent-shaped mass of gray matter forming part of the corpus striatum and part of the basal ganglia.

name: cephalic
definition: In or relating to the head.

name: ceramide
definition: Family of lipid molecules, each one composed of sphingosine and a fatty acid.

name: cerebellar tonsillar herniation
definition: Abnormal protrusion of a portion of the cerebellum through the foramen magnum of the skull.

name: cerebellum
definition: Lower part of the brain that is beneath the posterior portion of the cerebrum, regulating the unconscious coordination of movement.

name: cerebroside
definition: Member of a group of glycosphingolipids called monoglycosylceramides which are important components in animal nerve and muscle cell membranes and the myelin sheath.

name: cerebrum
definition: Principal part of the brain in vertebrates, located frontwards in the skull, consisting of the two hemispheres of the cerebral cortex separated by a fissure, and certain subcortical structures such as the hippocampus, basal ganglia, and the olfactory bulb.

name: cervical spine
definition: Part of the spine immediately inferior to the skull and connecting to the thoracic spine, made up of seven vertebrae.

name: cervical vertebra
definition: Any of seven vertebrae that provide strength and structure to the cervical spine and support the head, allowing for its rotation and flexion.

name: cholinergic
definition: Relating to or denoting a nerve that liberates acetylcholine at a synapse upon receiving an appropriate nerve impulse; in particular referring to parasympathetic nerve fibers. Relating to or denoting an agent that mimics or enhances the activity of acetylcholine.

name: cholinomimetic
definition: Having an action similar to acetylcholine.

name: chorea
definition: Neurological disorder characterized by rapid, jerky involuntary movements affecting especially the limbs or facial muscles.

name: choreoathetosis
definition: Occurrence of involuntary movements in a combination of chorea and athetosis.

name: chromatolysis
definition: Disintegration of nuclear chromatin. Disintegration of Nissl bodies following neuronal injury.

name: chronic solvent-induced encephalopathy
definition: Constellation of neurological symptoms that may include polyneuropathies, encephalopathy, memory loss, attention deficit and dementia following long-term exposure, often occupational, to organic solvents found in paints, glues, and other industrial products.

name: ciguatera poisoning
definition: Food-borne illness caused by ingesting fish containing ciguatera toxins.

name: ciliary muscle
definition: Intrinsic smooth muscle of the eye that contracts to cause the lens to thicken, allowing accommodation to near vision.

name: ciliary neurotrophic factor
definition: Polypeptide hormone and nerve growth factor that promotes neurotransmitter synthesis and neurite outgrowth in certain neural populations including astrocytes.

name: clonus
definition: Alternate involuntary muscular contraction and relaxation in rapid succession. Continuous rhythmic reflex tremor initiated by the spinal cord below an area of spinal cord injury, set in motion by reflex testing.

name: cognition
definition: Sum of the mental processes by which sensory input is stored, recovered, and used by the consciousbrain, including attention, memory, language usage, learning, reasoning, problem solving, and decision making.

name: coma
definition: State of profound unconsciousness lasting more than several hours in which one cannot respond to stimuli and from which one cannot be roused.

name: conditioned avoidance response test
definition: Experimental procedure in which an adverse effect (e.g., foot shock, drug withdrawal) is delivered to rats or mice after presentation of a cue (e.g., light or sound); the rodents are trained to avoid rather than escape the shock after the start of its delivery.

name: classical conditioning
definition: Learning in which a behavior comes to be elicited as a reflex response by association with a neutral antecedent stimulus through repetition of the stimulus-response pairing.

name: operant conditioning
definition: Learning in which appropriate behavior is rewarded, or inappropriate behavior is punished; behavior is modified by learned association with antecedents and consequences.

name: confusion
definition: Mental state of bewilderment or disorientation in which reactions to environmental stimuli may be inappropriate.

name: conscious
definition: Aware of and responding to one’s surroundings.

name: continuous performance test
definition: Any of several available neuropsychological procedures that measure a person’s sustained attention.

name: contracture
definition: Persistent shortening and tightening of muscle, tendon, or other tissue.

name: contrast medium
definition: Any material (usually opaque to X-rays) employed to delineate or define a structure during a radiologic procedure.

name: cornu ammonis
definition: Part of the hippocampus.

name: coronal
definition: Vertical (longitudinal) plane dividing the body into ventral and dorsal (front and back) sections.

name: coronal suture
definition: Transverse junction in the skull separating the frontal bone from the parietal bones.

name: corpus callosum
definition: Bundle of myelin-enriched neural fibers beneath the cortex connecting the two hemispheres of the brain.

name: corpus striatum
definition: Striatum together with the globus pallidus.

name: cramp
definition: Painful muscle spasm caused by prolonged tetanic contraction.

name: cranial nerve
definition: Each of 12 pairs of nerves that arise directly from the brain, not from the spinal cord, and pass through separate apertures in the skull.

name: craniopharyngioma
definition: Congenital tumor arising from the pituitary gland in the embryonic tissue between the brain and pharynx.

name: cue
definition: Stimulus or associated feature of a stimulus that evokes a response or alerts the subject to a particular behavior.

name: delirium
definition: State of severe confusion, characterized by restlessness, hallucinations and hyperactivity, during which the person affected may be isolated from normal communication.

name: dementia
definition: Serious loss of brain function in a previously unimpaired person, affecting memory, thinking, and behavior.

name: presenile dementia
definition: Dementia, often of the Alzheimer type (see Alzheimer disease) developing at or before age 65.

name: senile dementia
definition: Dementia, often of the Alzheimer type (see Alzheimer disease) developing after the age of 65.

name: demyelination
definition: Destruction of the protective myelin sheath that surrounds nerve fibers, resulting in diminished function and decreased action potential in those nerves.

name: dentate gyrus
definition: Narrow strip of cerebral cortex associated with the hippocampus that continues forward to the uncus.

name: chemical dependency
definition: Craving for or addiction to a substance.

name: depolarization
definition: Relative reduction in the resting membrane potential of an excitable cell, generally making the inside less negative, or even positive with respect to the outside.

name: depression
definition: Reduction in the activity of the central nervous system. Mental state or disorder characterized by feelings of sadness and despair.

name: developmental neurotoxicity
definition: Adverse effects of toxic substances on the development of the nervous system.

name: developmental neurotoxicity testing
definition: Any examination that allows detection of substance-induced changes in the structural or functional integrity of the nervous system of a developing organism, fetus or child.

name: diaphoretic
definition: n. Substance inducing perspiration. adj. Of a human, sweating heavily.

name: diarrheal shellfish poisoning
definition: Serious illness characterized primarily by diarrhea with rapid onset and resolution after \(\pu{24 h}\) that is a consequence of consumption of bivalve shellfish (mollusks) such as mussels, oysters, and clams that have ingested, by filter feeding, large quantities of dinoflagellates containing a group of high-molecular-weight structures with multiple ether linkages, such as okadaic acid, dinophysis toxins, pectenotoxins, and yessotoxin.

name: differentiation
definition: Process by which a cell is committed to a lineage and becomes more specialized in structure and function.

name: digit span test
definition: Test of memory in which numbers (series of digits) are presented orally or on a computer screen to a test subject who is asked to repeat each number from memory; the numbers increase in length until mistakes are made.

name: digit symbol substitution test
definition: Neuropsychological assessment in which the top two rows of a test sheet function as a key, displaying numbers 1–9 (upper row) matched to 'non-sense' symbols (lower row). There follow pairs of rows where the numbers 1–9 appear in irregular sequence and the test subject must match the correct symbol from the key to each number, as quickly as possible.

name: diplopia
definition: Simultaneous perception of two images of a single object.

name: intervertebral disc
definition: Flat circular structure, consisting of a tough, fibrous exterior and a gelatinous core, interposed between adjacent vertebrae.

name: disorientation
definition: Loss of sense of direction. In clinical assessment, lack of awareness of one’s identity, present location, or the current day and time.

name: domoic acid
definition: Neurotoxickainic acid analog produced by some algal blooms that causes amnesic shellfish poisoning.

name: dopamine
definition: Naturally occurring substance functioning as a neurotransmitter in the sympathetic nervous system, and a metabolic precursor of other substances including adrenalin.

name: dopaminergic
definition: Relating to a nerve that releases or responds to dopamine as a neurotransmitter.

name: dorsal root
definition: Outgrowth of a spinal nerve that carries sensory signals to an appropriate integration center in the brain.

name: dorsal root ganglion
definition: Nodule on a dorsal root of the spine that consists of afferent sensory neuronal cell bodies.

name: dura mater
definition: Outermost and most fibrous of the three membranes of the meninges (see meninx) covering the brain and the spinal cord.

name: dynein
definition: Protein associated with motile structures that exhibits adenosine triphosphatase activity; it forms 'arms' on the outer microtubules of cilia and flagella and functions as a molecular motor.

name: dynorphin
definition: Member of a class of opioid peptides that arise from the precursor protein prodynorphin.

name: dysaphia
definition: Impairment of the sense of touch.

name: dysarthria
definition: Difficulty in speech owing to disturbances of muscular control resulting from central or peripheral nervous system damage or emotional stress.

name: dysesthesia
definition: Condition in which a disagreeable sensation, especially of touch, is produced following damage to peripheral or central sensory pathways. Abnormal sensation experienced in the absence of stimulation.

name: dysgraphia
definition: Difficulty in writing.

name: dyskinesia
definition: Difficulty or abnormality in voluntary movement.

name: tardive dyskinesia
definition: Involuntary, repetitive body movement of slow onset.

name: dyslexia
definition: Impairment in appreciation of spatial relations, often leading to difficulty in reading.

name: dysphagia
definition: Difficulty in swallowing.

name: dysphasia
definition: Difficulty in the use of language owing to a brain lesion, without mental impairment.

name: autonomic dysreflexia
definition: Over-activity of the autonomic nervous system causing an abrupt onset of excessively high blood pressure, tachycardia, and constriction of peripheral blood vessels.

name: dystonia
definition: State of abnormal (either hypo- or hypertonic) muscle tone resulting in impairment of voluntary movement.

name: efferent
definition: Carrying outward; of nerves, those that conduct impulses outward from the central nervous system.

name: electroconvulsive therapy
definition: Therapeutic intervention in which seizures are electrically induced in patients with the aim of providing relief from a specific mental illness.

name: electroencephalogram
definition: Test or record of brain electrical activity detected by electroencephalography.

name: electroencephalography
definition: Recording of electrical activity from different parts of the brain.

name: electromyography
definition: Recording of the electrical activity of muscle, or its representation as a visual display or audible signal, using electrodes attached to the skin or inserted into a muscle.

name: electroneurography
definition: Non-invasive method used to examine the integrity and conductivity of a peripheral nerve, in which a brief electrical stimulation is given to the nerve at one point, while at the same time the induced electrical activity (compound action potentials) is recorded at another point of the nerve’s distribution and the interval is displayed on a video monitor.

name: electrophysiology
definition: Study of the electrical properties of cells and tissues.

name: electroretinogram
definition: Recording, with electrodes placed on the cornea or nearby skin, of the electrical activity of photoreceptors and other retinal cells in response to standardized, patterned stimuli with light and colour.

name: elevated plus maze
definition: Stage with four orthogonal side arms elevated above the floor, where two opposite arms have sidewalls and the other two arms have no walls; used as research tool for anxiety.

name: emesis
definition: Vomiting.

name: emetic
definition: n. Substance that produces vomiting. adj. Producing vomiting.

name: encephalopathy
definition: Any disorder of the brain that affects its functioning.

name: endocrine disruptor
definition: Exogenous chemical that alters function(s) of the endocrine system and consequently causes adverse health effects in an intact organism, its progeny, or (sub)populations.

name: endorphin
definition: One of several peptides (including the enkephalins) that activates the body’s opiate receptors, causing an analgesic effect; literally, endogenous morphine-like substance.

name: enkephalin
definition: Either of two endogenous pentapeptides with opiate-like effects that are especially involved in modulating pain responses in the central nervous system.

name: ependymal tissue
definition: Glial cells that line the cavities within the brain’sventricles.

name: ependymoma
definition: Growth in the brain or spinal cord arising from ependymal tissue.

name: epidural
definition: Immediately outside the dura mater.

name: epithalamus
definition: Dorsal part of the diencephalon, including the pineal gland and adjacent structures in the roof of the third ventricle.

name: ergotism
definition: Poisoning produced by eating food affected by ergot (ergotamine alkaloids), substances produced by the fungus Claviceps purpurea that contaminate rye and wheat.

name: euphoria
definition: Characterized by or feeling intense excitement and happiness.

name: evoked potential
definition: Electrical potential that is triggered by presentation of a stimulus (somatosensory, auditory, visual) and measured with electrodes near the nerve or near the brain region in which the signal is processed.

name: evoked response
definition: Electrical potential recorded from the nervous system following exposure to a stimulus, as distinct from spontaneous potentials detected by electroencephalography, electromyography, or other electrophysiological recording methods.

name: excitable cell
definition: Cell that can be stimulated to create an electric current; muscle fibers and nerve cells are excitable (see excitation).

name: excitatory post-synaptic potential
definition: Referring to a more positive membrane potential at the postsynaptic side of the synaptic cleft that renders the postsynaptic neuron more likely to generate an action potential.

name: excitotoxicity
definition: Pathological process by which neurons are damaged and killed by the overactivation of receptors for the excitatory neurotransmitter glutamate, such as the N-methyl-D-aspartic acid (NMDA) receptor and the 2-amino-3-(3-hydroxy-5-methyl-1,2-oxazol-4-yl)propanoic acid (AMPA) receptor.

name: facilitation
definition: Neural facilitation: Increase in postsynaptic excitation as a result of very rapid firing of action potentials by a presynaptic neuron. Presynaptic facilitation: Increase of presynaptic excitation when an excited neuron receives additional excitatory impulses from other neurons.

name: falx
definition: Continuation of dura mater between the right and left hemispheres of the brain.

name: fasciculation
definition: Involuntary contractions, or twitchings, of groups (fasciculi) of muscle fibers.

name: fibrillation
definition: Rapid contractions or twitching of muscle fibrils, but not of the muscle as a whole.

name: finger tapping test
definition: Procedure in which a test subject is asked to tap a finger at maximal rate on a surface, a higher rate of tapping indicating better neuromuscular function.

name: flaccid
definition: Relaxed, flabby, or without tone.

name: frontal lobe
definition: Most anterior of the four major lobes of each cerebral hemisphere, containing the primary motor cortex.

name: frontotemporal dementia
definition: Neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive neuronal defects in the frontal and temporal lobes of the brain, leading to dementia.

name: functional domain
definition: In the brain, referring to the concept that discrete regions are involved in specific aspects of cognitive function, thus giving rise to modularity.

name: functional observational battery
definition: Structured set of tests to examine changes in neuromuscular, arousal, autonomic and sensory functions that assesses the presence, absence or severity of specific neurological signs.

name: fused in sarcoma transcription factor
definition: Nuclear DNA- and RNA-binding protein involved in transcription, splicing, and RNA-transport.

name: GABAergic
definition: Pertaining to the action of $\ce{\upgamma\!\mbox{-}aminobutyric acid}$ or to neural or metabolic pathways in which it functions as a neurotransmitter.

name: ganglion
definition: Cluster of nerve cell bodies located outside the brain and spinal cord, i.e., in the peripheral nervous system.Note: Ganglia interconnect to form a complex network known as a plexus and serve as relay stations where different neurons can modulate the signals of each other. Compare: basal ganglion. Fibrous cyst usually attached to a tendon sheath.

name: ganglion cell
definition: Neuron located in a ganglion.

name: ganglioside
definition: Glycosphingolipid chemically similar to cerebrosides but containing one or more sialic (N-acetylneuraminic or N-glycolylneuraminic) acid residues, found principally in nerve tissue, spleen, and thymus.

name: giant axon
definition: Very large axon (typically \(\pu{0.5 mm}\) in diameter) that functions in the propulsion system of the squid.

name: giant axonal neuropathy
definition: Rare human genetic neurological disorder in which the neurofilaments become disordered, resulting in abnormal size and shape of neurons.

name: glia
definition: Non-neuronal cellular elements of the central and peripheral nervous system having metabolic and support functions.

name: glial cell
definition: Cellular component of the glia, including oligodendroglial cells, astrocytes, ependymal cells and microglial cells.

name: glial-derived neurotrophic factor
definition: Protein that promotes and guides the growth of neurons and facilitates the survival of mature neurons by suppressing cell death.

name: glial fibrillary acidic protein
definition: Cytoskeletal intermediate filament protein found in mature fibrillary astrocytes and in neural progenitor cells.

name: glioblastoma
definition: Glioma consisting chiefly of undifferentiated anaplastic cells of astrocytic origin.

name: glioma
definition: Neoplasm originating from any of the glia cells in the brain and spinal cord.

name: reactive gliosis
definition: Damage-induced proliferation, enlargement and overgrowth of glial cells, often astrocytes in the central nervous system, resulting in an astrocytic scar.

name: globoside
definition: Glycosphingolipid, specifically a ceramide tetrasaccharide (tetraglycosylceramide), isolated from kidney and erythrocytes.

name: glutamate
definition: Salt of glutamic acid (2-aminopentanedioic acid).

name: glutamate-induced excitotoxicity
definition: Form of excitotoxicity where excess glutamate release in synapses (glutamatergic storm) leads to overstimulation, followed by excess cellular calcium uptake, cytotoxicity and apoptosis.

name: Golgi staining
definition: Method of silver staining of histological sections of tissue from the nervous system, in which a limited number of neurons stain in their entirety upon formation of microcrystals of silver chromate, thus allowing visualization in the light microscope of some individual neurons in densely packed tissue.

name: G protein-coupled receptor
definition: Seven-transmembrane-domain receptor that interacts with guanosine triphosphate/diphosphate (GTP/GDP) binding proteins to initiate signal transduction.

name: granule cell
definition: One of several types of neurons with small cell bodies, involved in neural networks in several regions of the brain, including the cerebellum, hippocampus, and cerebral cortex.

name: Guillain–Barré syndrome
definition: Type of idiopathic polyneuritis in which autoimmunity to peripheral nerve, myelin leads to a condition characterized by chronic demyelination of the spinal roots (see spinal cord), peripheral nerves, and cranial nerves.

name: habituation
definition: Decrease or cessation of a response to a stimulus after its repeated presentation.

name: hallucination
definition: The apparent, often strong, subjective perception of an external object or event when no such stimulus or situation is present.

name: headache
definition: Pain in one or more parts of the cranium, not confined to the area of distribution of any nerve.

name: rebound headache
definition: Headache caused by stopping analgesics following their overuse to relieve headaches.

name: tension headache
definition: Headache associated with anxiety or other states of distress, associated with chronic contraction of the scalp muscles.

name: hematoma
definition: Region of bleeding into a tissue or organ.

name: hemiplegia
definition: Paralysis of one side of the body, including the arm, trunk and leg.

name: dominant hemisphere
definition: Cerebralhemisphere containing the representation of speech and controlling arm and leg preference in skilled movements.

name: hemorrhage
definition: Copious escape of blood from a disrupted blood vessel.

name: hen test
definition: Procedure using birds to study acute and delayed neurotoxicity, notably of organophosphates.

name: hippocampal slice culture
definition: Maintenance in vitro of fresh prepared slices of the hippocampus.

name: histamine
definition: Bioactive metabolite produced in living organisms by deamination of the amino acid histidine.

name: histaminergic
definition: Pertaining to the action of histamine or to neural pathways in which it functions as a neurotransmitter.

name: Huntington disease
definition: Genetic autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disease resulting from a mutation in the Huntingtin gene and resulting notably in decline of cognitive function and a characteristic chorea.

name: communicating hydrocephalus
definition: Hydrocephalus where flow of cerebrospinal fluid is not blocked but there is failure of its reabsorption.

name: obstructive hydrocephalus
definition: Hydrocephalus where flow of the cerebrospinal fluid is blocked.

name: hydromyelia
definition: Pathological dilation of the spinal cord due to expansion of the cerebrospinal fluid-filled central canal of the cord.

name: 5-hydroxytryptamine
definition: Neurotransmitter found in the digestive tract, platelets and central nervous system.

name: hypercapnia
definition: Abnormally increased carbon dioxide concentration in the blood resulting in a increased rate and depth of breathing.

name: hyperesthesia
definition: Excessive sensitivity to touch, pain, or other sensory stimuli.

name: hyperpolarization
definition: Transient increase in membrane polarization of nerve cells or muscle cells; the opposite of depolarization.

name: hyperreflexia
definition: Increased or exaggerated reflex response.

name: hypertonia
definition: Extreme tension of the muscles or arteries.

name: hypnotic
definition: Agent that may reduce anxiety and induces sleep.

name: hypocapnia
definition: Abnormally decreased carbon dioxide concentration in the blood.

name: hypophysectomy
definition: Surgical removal of the pituitary gland (hypophysis).

name: hyporeflexia
definition: Diminished reflex response.

name: hypotension
definition: Subnormal arterial blood pressure.Note: Hypotension can be a cause of dizziness, weakness and fainting. Lower than normal pressure or tension of any kind (used less commonly).

name: hypotonia
definition: Condition in which there is a diminution or loss of muscle tone. Relaxation of the arteries. Lower than normal tension in any part, as in intraocular pressure of the eyeball.

name: ictus
definition: Sudden attack, stroke or seizure.

name: inclusion body
definition: Particle in a cell, detectable under the light microscope.

name: inferior cerebellar peduncle
definition: Part of the cerebellum that is important for a number of motor functions, including balance, position sensing and coordination of movement.

name: inflammation
definition: Reaction of the body to injury or to infectious, allergic, or chemical irritation; characterized by redness, swelling, heat, and pain resulting from dilation of the blood vessels accompanied by loss of plasma and leukocytes into the tissues.

name: infratentorial
definition: Below the tentorium.

name: inhibitory post-synaptic potential
definition: Referring to a more negative membrane potential at the postsynaptic side of the synaptic cleft that renders the postsynaptic neuron less likely to generate an action potential.

name: insecticide
definition: Substance intended to kill insects.

name: insomnia
definition: Inability to sleep during the period when sleep should normally occur.

name: intelligence quotient
definition: Numeric measure of a person’s cognitive function based on one of several standardized tests of a problem-solving nature.

name: intracranial pressure
definition: Pressure within the cranial cavity.

name: intrathecal
definition: Within a sheath, as within either the subarachnoid or the subdural space.

name: ion channel
definition: Pore-forming transmembrane protein that can gate the transmembrane flux of small ions.

name: ion channelopathy
definition: Neuromuscular disease resulting from a genetic defect in an ion channel.

name: ionized calcium-binding adapter molecule 1
definition: Protein that is expressed in several tissues, but in brain is a specific immunomarker for microglia.

name: Irwin battery
definition: Set of neurobehavioral tests, including observations of behavior in novel environments, of reactions, and of motor functions; used in various modifications and resembling the functional observational battery.

name: kainic acid
definition: Natural amino acid produced by some seaweeds that activates a subclass of glutamate receptors ('kainate receptors') to produce excitotoxicity.

name: kindling
definition: Increase of epileptogenic activities as a result of repeated, longer-lasting subthreshold brain stimulation, e.g., with electrical stimuli.

name: lacrimation
definition: Secretion and discharge of tears.

name: Lanthony D-15 color test
definition: Test of color vision using 15 distinct color chips with low color saturation that have to be arranged in a correct order.

name: latent
definition: Not yet manifest; dormant but potentially discernible.

name: lathyrism
definition: Disease characterised by spastic paralysis of the legs and lower part of the body, pain, hyperesthesia, and paresthesia.

name: lethargy
definition: Relatively mild impairment of consciousness resulting in reduced alertness and awareness.

name: levarterenol
definition: Levorotatory isomer of norepinephrine, having greater pressor activity than the natural dextrorotatory isomer.

name: libido
definition: Conscious or unconscious sexual desire; passionate interest in life force.

name: ligand-gated ion channel
definition: Ion channel that opens upon binding an activating ligand.

name: limbic system
definition: Collection of interconnected neurons lying underneath the cerebrum on either side of the thalamus, related more by anatomical location than as a single functional entity.

name: lipoma
definition: Benign tumor of the adipose tissue, often visible under the skin.

name: lobe
definition: One of the four main regions of the cerebral cortex.

name: lower motor neuron
definition: Neuron that receives impulses from an upper motor neuron and whose axons innervate the skeletal muscles.

name: lumbar spine
definition: Portion of the vertebral column of the lower back between the thoracic spine and sacrum, in humans consisting of five vertebrae designated L1 to L5.

name: magnetic resonance spectroscopy
definition: Noninvasive method based on nuclear spin alignment that allows localization of levels and measurement of kinetics of an injected labeled substances in living tissue.

name: manganism
definition: Condition of manganese poisoning, usually after chronic inhalation exposure to manganese fumes.

name: maze
definition: Labyrinthine system, in which the ability of an animal (usually a rodent) to find a direct route from a starting point to a specific location is observed.

name: medulloblastoma
definition: Highly malignant, invasive brain tumor of embryonal origin, arising in the posterior fossa, usually from the cerebellum.

name: membrane polarization
definition: Occurrence of a potential difference across a biological membrane.

name: meninges
definition: Plural of meninx.

name: meningioma
definition: Firm, often vascular, tumor arising from the meninges of the brain or spinal cord.

name: meningitis
definition: Inflammation or infection of the meninges.

name: meningoencephalitis
definition: Inflammation of the brain and meninges.

name: meningoencephalocele
definition: Protrusion of both the meninges and brain tissue through a defect in the skull.

name: mental retardation
definition: Formerly used term to describe intellectual disability.

name: mentation
definition: Mental activity, conscious or unconscious, but especially referring to thinking and reasoning.

name: N-methyl-D-aspartate
definition: Excitotoxic non-essential amino acid used experimentally to identify a specific subset of glutamatereceptors.

name: N-methyl-D-aspartate-type glutamate receptor
definition: One of the various types of receptors of the neurotransmitterglutamate.

name: 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine
definition: Synthetic substance causing parkinsonism.

name: microglial cell
definition: Small glial cell; resident macrophage derived as a mononuclear phagocyte that populates the brain in early development.

name: microgliosis
definition: Morphological response of microglia to injury, characterized by hypertrophy and amoeboid morphology.

name: migraine
definition: Recurrent syndrome usually characterized by unilateral head pain accompanied by symptoms including nausea and vomiting, vertigo, photophobia and other visual phenomena.

name: migrainous infarction
definition: Stroke that occurs in connection with a migraine attack.

name: Minnesota multiphasic personality inventory
definition: Questionnaire type of psychological test for ages 18 and older. The RF version has 338 true–false statements with seven validity and ten personality scales that may be used in either an individual or group format.

name: miosis
definition: Abnormal contraction of the pupil of the eye to less than \(\pu{2 mm}\).

name: misfolded protein
definition: Protein that has the same amino acid sequence as the normal, functional protein but exhibits a deviant tertiary structure and lacks normal function.

name: mitochondrial membrane potential
definition: Membrane potential across the inner membrane of the mitochondrion generated by the electron transport chain.

name: mixed neuropathy
definition: Dysfunction or degeneration of both motor and sensory nerves.

name: Monro–Kellie hypothesis
definition: Hypothesis that the intracranial volume is unchangeable and therefore a constant intracranial pressure requires that the sum of the volumes of the three compartments blood, brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid remains constant.

name: morphine
definition: The major phenanthrene alkaloid of opium, used as an analgesic, sedative, and anxiolytic.

name: motor activity
definition: Physical activity and performance of an animal.

name: motor coordination
definition: Cooperation of the motor neurons and the involved muscles to perform a body movement precisely according to spatiotemporal requirements.

name: motor cortex
definition: Region of the cerebral cortex, located primarily in the frontal lobe, involved in coordinating motor activity.

name: motor endplate
definition: Complex structure by which the axon of a motor neuron establishes synaptic contact with a skeletal muscle fiber.

name: motor neuron
definition: Nerve cell in the spinal cord having an axon that leaves the central nervous system to establish a functional connection with an effector (muscle or glandular) tissue.

name: motor neuron disease
definition: Generic term for a heterogeneous group of disorders, all affecting motor neurons in the brain, spinal cord, or both.

name: motor system
definition: Part of the central nervous system responsible for control of movement, consisting of the pyramidal system controlling voluntary movement and the extrapyramidal system coordinating involuntary movement.

name: multiple chemical sensitivity
definition: Intolerance condition attributed to extreme sensitivity of individuals to various environmental chemicals, found in air, food, water, building materials, or fabrics.

name: multiple sclerosis
definition: Common demyelinating (see demyelination) disorder of the central nervous system, causing patches of sclerosis (plaques) in the brain and spinal cord.

name: muscarinic
definition: Referring to agents that stimulate the postganglionicparasympatheticreceptor, named after the prototypical mushroom alkaloid, muscarine [2,5-anhydro-1,4,6-trideoxy-6-(trimethylammonio)-D-ribo-hexitol].

name: muscarinic receptor
definition: One of the two main classes of acetylcholine receptors that responds to muscarinic agents.

name: muscle spindle
definition: Sensory organ in the body of a striated muscle containing afferent and efferentnerve fibers that detect passive muscle stretch and convey information to the central nervous system to cause reflex resistance to this stretch.

name: mydriasis
definition: Dilation of the pupil.

name: myelin
definition: Electrically insulating lipoprotein layers that are produced by glial cells and surround the axons of the neurons.

name: myelin basic protein
definition: Major component of myelin, that helps organizing the correct assembly of the lipids and proteins in myelin sheets.

name: myelin-associated glycoprotein
definition: Transmembrane glycoprotein that plays an important role in the interaction between axons and myelin and affects myelination during nerve regeneration.

name: myelin sheath
definition: Concentric layers of myelin surrounding the axons of some neurons.

name: myelogram
definition: X-ray of the spinal canal following injection of a contrast material into the surrounding cerebrospinal fluid spaces.

name: myelomeningocele
definition: Protrusion of the spinal cord and its coverings through a defect in the vertebral column.

name: myelopathy
definition: Any functional or pathologic disturbance in the spinal cord. Disorder of the myelopoietic tissues of the bone marrow.

name: myopathy
definition: Any disease of muscle.

name: myotonia
definition: Prolonged contraction or delayed relaxation of a muscle after mechanical or brief electrical stimulation.

name: NG2 cell
definition: Glial cell of the central nervous system, distinct from an oligodendrocyte or astrocyte, that may serve as a precursor of oligodendrocytes, and that takes its name from expression of proteoglycan NG2.

name: narcosis
definition: Nonspecific, reversible depression of central nervous system function, marked by stupor or unconsciousness.

name: narcotic
definition: Nonspecific usage – an agent that produces insensibility or stupor. Specific usage – any natural or synthetic substance that has morphine-like actions.

name: neocortex
definition: Outer layer of the cerebral cortex that supports higher brain functions, especially cognitive function and language in humans.

name: nerve
definition: Ensheathed bundle of nerve fibers that conveys information between the central nervous system and other regions of the body.

name: nerve conduction study
definition: Measure of the functional integrity of a nerve with a stimulating electrode, placed on the skin over the nerve, and a more distal recording electrode, to determine the velocity of the impulse that passes along the nerve between the electrodes.

name: nerve conduction velocity
definition: Rate of progression of a nerve impulse in a peripheral nerve or in its largest component nerve fibers.

name: nerve fiber
definition: Axon with its surrounding myelin sheath.

name: nerve gas
definition: Volatile chemical with neurotoxic features intended for use in warfare to disable or kill the organism rapidly after inhalation or skin contact, and classified as a prohibited weapon of mass destruction by The Chemical Weapons Convention (CWC).

name: nerve growth factor
definition: One of a family of proteins known as neurotropins that function as signaling molecules to induce axon growth, branching, elongation and survival of neurons.

name: nerve root
definition: Proximal end of a spinal nerve nearest its attachment to the spinal cord.

name: nervous system
definition: The entire neuronal apparatus, composed of both the central nervous system and the peripheral nervous system.

name: neural activity
definition: Metabolic and electrical activity of neurons.

name: neuralgia
definition: Paroxysmal pain extending along the course of one or more nerves.

name: neural network
definition: A functionally interconnected set of neurons, generally in the central nervous system.

name: neural stem cell
definition: Multipotent cell, with mitotic potential, that may serve as a precursor for neuroprogenitor cells.

name: neurectomy
definition: Excision of a nerve or part of a nerve.

name: neurite
definition: Outgrowth or projection of either an axon or a dendrite from the neuron cell body that is the structural basis of the neural network.

name: neurite outgrowth
definition: Phenomenon in which neurons tend to send out neurites to make contact with other nerve cells.

name: neuritis
definition: Inflammation of a nerve.

name: neurobehavior core test battery
definition: A set of seven tests, recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO) in 1983, to detect neurotoxicity in human populations

name: neurodegenerative disease
definition: Disease of the brain and (or) peripheral nervous system with progressive loss of neuronal function, accompanied by changes in morphology and subcellular organization of the nervous system.

name: neurodevelopmental toxicity
definition: Adverse effect of a substance that disrupts developmental processes of the nervous system. Toxicity in which the developing nervous system shows heightened sensitivity compared with the adult nervous system.

name: neurofibril
definition: Part of a filamentous structure found in the cell body, axons, dendrites, and sometimes synaptic endings of neurons, consisting of bundles of neurofilaments and neurotubules.

name: neurofibrillary tangle
definition: Intracellular accumulation of aggregates of hyperphosphorylated tau protein or paired helical filaments consisting of the tau protein, a microtubule-associated protein that normally stabilizes the cytoskeleton.

name: neurofibroma
definition: Tumor of the peripheral nervous system representing an abnormal collection of Schwann cells and connective tissue.

name: neurofilament
definition: Class of intermediate filament of the neuronal cytoskeleton, providing support for the axon and dendrites.

name: neurogenesis
definition: Formation of nerve cells or of the nervous system.

name: neurogenic
definition: Originating in, starting from, or caused by, the nervous system or nerve impulses. Relating to neurogenesis.

name: neurogenic shock
definition: Condition of decreased blood pressure, slow heart rate and insufficient perfusion of the body with blood, caused by loss of autonomic control following acute trauma to the brain or spinal cord.

name: neuroimaging
definition: Process of producing images of the structure or activity of the brain or other parts of the nervous system.

name: neuroinflammation
definition: Complex series of local immune responses within the nervous system to deal with a threat to the neural environment from infection, injury, or trauma.

name: neuroleptic
definition: Any of a class of psychotropic drugs used to treat psychosis, particularly schizophrenia.

name: neurolysis
definition: Breakdown of nervous tissue from disease or injury. Therapeutic destruction of a nerve or nerves to treat intractable pain. Surgical freeing of a nerve from adhesions of the neural sheath.

name: neuroma
definition: Tumor made up largely of nerve cells.

name: neuronopathy
definition: Disorder involving destruction of the cell bodies of neurons.

name: neuron-specific enolase
definition: Enzyme of glucose metabolism, normally found in nervous tissue, that catalyzes the dehydration of 2-phosphoglycerate.

name: neuropathological examination
definition: Application of gross and histopathologic methods to study toxic changes in the morphology and histology of the nervous tissues and the brain.

name: neuropathy
definition: Pathological change in the peripheral nervous system.

name: neuropathy target esterase
definition: Enzyme that is phosphorylated by organophosphate compounds and is believed to be involved in the delayed neuropathy of organophosphates.

name: neuroprogenitor cell
definition: Precursor cell that is capable of differentiating into specific cell types of the nervous system.

name: neuroprotective
definition: Agent or property of an agent that protects neurons from damage and (or) from the process of aging or degeneration of the brain.

name: neuropsychological testing
definition: Assessment, under standardized conditions, of an individual’s brain function as it impacts upon cognitive function, thought processes, behavior and personality.

name: neurotoxic
definition: Poisonous to structures and (or) functions of the brain and nerves.

name: neurotoxicant
definition: Substance that can produce functional or structural damage to the nervous system.

name: neurotoxicology
definition: Discipline applying principles of both neuroscience and toxicology to study the ability of certain substances to alter nervous system structure or function.

name: neurotoxic shellfish poisoning
definition: Toxic shellfish poisoning characterized by nausea, vomiting, and mild neurological symptoms such as dysarthria, paresthesia, ataxia, and vertigo caused by ingestion of shellfish (specifically, bivalve molluscs) contaminated with the polyether brevetoxin and its derivatives produced by the dinoflagellate Karenia brevis.

name: neurotoxin
definition: Any substance that has the potential to damage the nervous system.

name: neurotransmission
definition: Process by which a presynaptic cell, upon excitation, releases a specific agent (a neurotransmitter) that crosses the synapse to stimulate or inhibit the postsynaptic cell.

name: retrograde neurotransmission
definition: Neurotransmission wherein a neurotransmitter is sent from the postsynaptic to the presynaptic membrane in order to modify a signal.

name: neurotransmitter
definition: Biochemical that is released upon excitation from a presynaptic membrane, crosses the synaptic space and binds to a receptor on the postsynaptic membrane, where it induces a signal that may be either stimulatory or inhibitory.

name: neurotropic
definition: Having an affinity for nerve cells or tissues of the nervous system.

name: neurotubule
definition: Microtubule found in neurons.

name: neurovascular
definition: Relating to both the nervous system and the vascular system. Relating to the vasomotor nerves that supply the walls of the blood vessels.

name: nicotinic
definition: Referring to a substance or effect that mimics acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction, at autonomic ganglia and at other locations in the brain.

name: nicotinic receptor
definition: One of the two main classes of acetylcholine receptors, ligand-gated ion channels that open upon binding nicotine as well as acetylcholine.

name: nine-hole box test
definition: Behavioral test based on the five-choice serial reaction time task, which allows the study of attention based on a test animal learning from which hole (typically one of five open holes in an arc of nine) a visual (light) cue was given, with a food pellet reward for nose-poking the correct hole.

name: Nissl body
definition: Granular structure consisting of rough endoplasmic reticulum, found in neurons.

name: nociception
definition: Physiological response to harmful stimuli by specialized nerve endings that transmit a signal perceived as pain by the brain.

name: node of Ranvier
definition: Short interval in the myelin sheath of a nerve fiber where the axon is invested only by scant cytoplasmic processes of the neighboring Schwann cells or, in the central nervous system, of oligodendroglia cells.

name: nose-poke test
definition: Test allowing study of attention deficit based on noting the success of a test animal in gaining a food pellet reward for nosing the correct hole in a box.

name: numbness
definition: Imprecise term for absent or reduced touch perception, as well as paresthesia.

name: nystagmus
definition: Involuntary rhythmic oscillation of the eyeballs.

name: occipital lobe
definition: One of the four major lobes of each cerebral hemisphere, situated within the occiput, containing most of the neural apparatus of visual processing.

name: olfaction
definition: Detection of odors.

name: oligodendrocyte
definition: Type of glial cell that produces the myelin sheath in the central nervous system.

name: oligodendroglioma
definition: Glioma arising from the oligodendrocytes.

name: open field test
definition: Procedure to observe changes in motor activity and rearing, in which a rodent is placed on a surface and distance and patterns of movement are recorded.

name: opiate receptor
definition: One of a group of G-protein-coupled receptors that bind morphine and endogenous substances that have morphine-like effects.

name: opioid
definition: Synthetic narcotic having properties consistent with binding to opiate receptors, but not derived from opium.

name: opium
definition: Extract of the opium poppy, Papaver somniferum, containing morphine as a major psychoactive component.

name: organoleptic
definition: Relating to perception by a sensory organ. Involving the use of sensory organs, e.g., organoleptic tests.

name: organometallic compound
definition: Compound having covalent bonds between one or more metal atoms and one or more carbon atoms of an organyl group.

name: organophosphate
definition: Organic ester of phosphoric acid.

name: organophosphate-induced delayed neuropathy
definition: Disorder, typically with symptoms of pain and weakness in the extremities, resulting from neuronal death associated with organophosphate poisoning (either chronic or a late effect of acute poisoning).

name: osmophobia
definition: Morbid fear of odors.

name: oxidative stress
definition: Adverse effects occurring when the generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in a system exceeds the system’s ability to neutralize and eliminate them; excess ROS can damage a cell’s lipids, protein, and DNA.

name: pain
definition: Conscious awareness of an unpleasant sensation mediated by nerve conduction of a stimulus from a site of tissue injury to the brain. Note 1: Chemical mediators of pain include histamine, bradykinins, and prostaglandins. Note 2: The sensation may occur or persist when the injured tissue is no longer present, as in phantom pain. Sensation one feels when hurt in body or mind.

name: neuropathic pain
definition: Pain initiated by nerve injury, not mediated by nociception.

name: phantom pain
definition: Sensation that an amputated limb is still present, often associated with pain.

name: paired helical filament
definition: Describing the aggregation of hyperphosphorylated tau protein into neurofibrillary tangles.

name: palpitation
definition: Unduly rapid or throbbing heartbeat that is noted by a patient; it may be regular or irregular. Undue awareness by a patient of a heartbeat that is otherwise normal.

name: papilledema
definition: Edema of the region of the head of the optic nerve in the retina (the optic disc).

name: paralysis
definition: Total or partial loss of motor function.

name: paralytic shellfish poisoning
definition: Illness that is a consequence of consumption of bivalve molluscs such as mussels, oysters, and clams that have ingested large quantities of microalgae containing saxitoxin or its derivatives.

name: paraoxonase
definition: Any of several related enzymes that hydrolyze aryl esters and lactones, notably organophosphate pesticides including the acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, paraoxon.

name: paraplegia
definition: Paralysis of both lower limbs.

name: parasympathetic nervous system
definition: Division of the autonomic nervous system involved in stimulating digestive secretions, slowing heart rate, constricting the pupils of the eyes, and dilating blood vessels.

name: parasympathomimetic
definition: n., Substance that produces effects resembling those of impulses transmitted by the postganglionic fibers of the parasympathetic nervous system. adj., Producing effects resembling those of impulses transmitted by the postganglionic fibers of the parasympathetic nervous system.

name: paresis
definition: Slight or incomplete paralysis.

name: paresthesia
definition: Abnormal or unexplained tingling, pricking, or burning sensation on the skin.

name: parietal lobe
definition: One of the four major lobes of each cerebral hemisphere situated between the frontal and occipital lobes, above the temporal lobe.

name: Parkinson disease
definition: Degenerative disorder of the central nervous system resulting from decreased production of the neurotransmitterdopamine in the basal ganglia (notably the substantia nigra).

name: secondary parkinsonism
definition: Neurological syndrome resembling Parkinson disease and often resulting from decreased dopamine production as a consequence of neurodegenerative changes in the substantia nigra.

name: passive avoidance test
definition: Fear-motivated test in which rodents learn to avoid an otherwise preferred environment in which they are exposed to an aversive stimulus.

name: paw-reaching test
definition: Test used to reveal motor deficits, usually of central origin, exhibited on the contralateral side by reduced ability of a test animal to extend the forelimb.

name: PC-12 cell
definition: Cell of an established line originally derived from a pheochromocytoma of the rat adrenal medulla.

name: peripheral nervous system
definition: One of the two major divisions of the nervous system, made up of the nerves and ganglia lying outside the brain and spinal cord that transmit sensory and motor signals to and from the central nervous system.

name: peripheral neuropathy
definition: Neuropathy affecting nerves of the peripheral nervous system.

name: peristalsis
definition: Progression of a wave of smooth muscle contraction followed by relaxation along the length of a muscular tube.

name: pheochromocytoma
definition: Tumor of the chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla that results in excessive secretion of norepinephrine and other catecholamines.

name: phonophobia
definition: Abnormal fear of loud sound, or occasionally of voices.

name: photophobia
definition: Abnormal visual intolerance of light.

name: photoreceptor cell
definition: Specialized neuron found in the retina, involved in detecting light and transducing the signals of vision

name: pia
definition: Innermost of three membranous layers, together composing the meninges, that surrounds and adheres to the brain and spinal cord.

name: plexus
definition: Network of interconnecting nerves, blood vessels or lymphatic vessels.

name: pneumotaxic center
definition: Neural network in the brainstem involved in regulating respiration.

name: polyneuritis
definition: Inflammation of several peripheral nerves simultaneously.

name: polyneuropathy
definition: Neuropathy (distal axonopathy) of the peripheral nervous system, often affecting the extremities in a bilateral distribution, and characterized by numbness, tingling, and paresthesia.

name: posterior fossa
definition: Pocket in the back of the skull that accommodates the cerebellum and the midbrain.

name: postsynaptic
definition: Event or structure at the distal side of a synaptic cleft.

name: long-term potentiation
definition: Potentiation lasting up to several months.

name: presynaptic
definition: Event or structure at the proximal (transmitting) side of a synaptic cleft.

name: prodromal stage
definition: Phase before the onset of full-blown disease.

name: prodrome
definition: Symptom(s) heralding impending onset of a disease.

name: profile of mood state test
definition: Procedure in which a test subject is asked to indicate his/her mood during the past week, by quickly marking specified emotional words on a scale between 'not at all' and 'extremely.'

name: proprioception
definition: Sense of the movement or position of the body independent of vision.

name: proprioceptor
definition: Sensory organ in a muscle, tendon or joint capsule that senses position or state of contraction.

name: pseudobulbar affect
definition: Involuntary emotional outburst (typically crying or laughing).

name: pseudomeningocele
definition: Part of the cerebrospinal fluid that, in contrast to a meningocele, is not surrounded by dura.

name: pseudotumor cerebri
definition: Disorder with increased intracranial pressure, cerebral edema, and frequently papilledema, symptoms that resemble the effects of a tumor but without the occurrence of one.

name: psychoactive
definition: Having the ability to alter mood, behavior, cognitive function or mental state.

name: psychoneuroimmunology
definition: Study of links between the brain and the immune system, recognizing an interaction between psychological states and the outcome of immune responses to disease.

name: psychosis
definition: Disordered thought processes that may include changes in cognitive function, perception, belief, behavior and personality; altered awareness of reality.

name: organic psychosis
definition: Psychosis with a known physical (anatomic, disease-related or toxic) cause.

name: psychotropic
definition: Capable of affecting the mind, emotions and behavior.

name: puffer fish
definition: Marine fish of the order Tetraodontiformes and family Tetraodontidae.

name: Purkinje cell
definition: Large neuron forming part of a layer of cells in the cerebellum.

name: pursuit aiming test
definition: Procedure in which a subject is instructed to place a dot in defined sites (such as a number of circles), as quickly as possible.

name: putamen
definition: Part of the basal ganglia that plays a role in coordinating movement and learning.

name: pyknosis
definition: Clumping of nuclear chromatin and shrinkage of the cell nucleus during cell degeneration.

name: pyramidal cell
definition: Large neuron of the cerebral cortex having a triangular cell body in histological section with several dendrites at the base and one large apical axon.

name: pyrethroid
definition: Synthetic molecule with structural similarity to the natural pyrethrins found in plants of the genus Chrysanthemum.

name: quadriplegia
definition: Paralysis of both upper and both lower limbs.

name: radial arm maze
definition: Apparatus with a central platform and equidistant arms (usually eight), at the end of which is a reward (e.g., a food pellet).

name: radiculitis
definition: Inflammation of the spinal nerve roots leading to pain and hyperesthesia radiating along the nerve.

name: rearing
definition: Of a rodent or other animal raising itself on its hind legs.

name: rebound
definition: Reappearance of original symptom(s), often exacerbated, following cessation of treatment.

name: reflex
definition: Involuntary reaction in response to a stimulus applied to the periphery following its transmission to the nervous centers in the brain or spinal cord.

name: reflex sympathetic dystrophy
definition: Diffuse persistent pain usually in an extremity.

name: reinforcement
definition: Use of a stimulus in operant conditioning to increase the likelihood that a particular behavior will occur.

name: relaxant
definition: Agent that reduces muscle tension.

name: reperfusion
definition: Restoration of the blood supply to an organ or tissue following a period of ischemia.

name: repolarization
definition: Returning of a cell’s membrane potential to its resting potential following depolarization.

name: resolution phase
definition: Return to a sexually unexcited state following orgasm.

name: resting potential
definition: Baseline membrane potential.

name: retrograde axonal transport
definition: Transport of material from the nerve ending back to the cell body.

name: reuptake
definition: Transporter-dependent resequestration of a neurotransmitter by a presynapticneuron, terminating synaptic transmission.

name: Rey–Osterrieth complex figure test
definition: Procedure in which the test subject first copies a complicated drawing and then is asked to draw it from memory.

name: righting reflex
definition: Reflex that restores the correct orientation of the body when taken out of the upright position.

name: righting test
definition: Experimental measurement of an animal’s (usually a rodent’s) ability to land in an upright position at the end of a fall.

name: surface righting test
definition: Test animal is placed on its back and the time to retain an uprate position with four paws in contact with the surface is measured.

name: rotarod test
definition: Experimental observation of an animal’s (usually a rodent’s) ability to stay on a rotating rod without falling off.

name: saccadic eye movement
definition: Rapid or jerky movement of the eyes from one line of sight to another, as in reading or correction of a jerky nystagmus.

name: Saint Anthony fire
definition: Referring to inflammatory conditions of the skin such as erysipelas.

name: Santa Ana dexterity test
definition: Procedure in which a test subject stands in front of a plate with 48 square holes and an equal number of fitted pegs, each having a cylindrical upper part and square base, and is asked to fit the pegs into the holes as quickly as possible by turning them 180 degrees, first with one hand and in a subsequent trial with the other hand.

name: schedule-controlled operant behaviour
definition: Experimental procedure in which operant behavior is assessed following a conditioning stimulus delivered at a pre-determined duration and frequency ('schedule of reinforcement'), thus allowing comparison of the effects of magnitude, frequency and duration of the stimulus.

name: schedule of reinforcement
definition: Frequency, duration, dose, and (or) intensity of a conditioning stimulus.

name: Schwann cell
definition: Glial cell in the peripheral nervous system that produces myelin for the axons of the peripheral nerves.

name: sclerosis
definition: Hardening of an organ or tissue, especially that due to excessive growth of fibrous tissue.

name: Scombroid poisoning
definition: Constellation of symptoms resembling an allergic reaction, caused by eating the meat of decaying fish that has high levels of histamine (in this context sometimes referred to as scombrotoxin).

name: sedative
definition: Substance that exerts a soothing or tranquillizing effect, or describing the effect itself.

name: selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor
definition: Drug in a subclass of substances that interfere with the resequestration of serotonin by the presynaptic membrane.

name: senility
definition: Characteristics typically associated with old age, especially relating to memory loss and other mental impairment.

name: sensory neuron
definition: Nerve cell specialized for detecting and transducing signals from external or somatic stimuli.

name: serotoninergic
definition: Relating to a nerve that releases or responds to serotonin as a neurotransmitter.

name: shellfish poisoning
definition: Illness associated with consumption of seafood contaminated with toxins.

name: shunt
definition: n. Fistula or prosthetic device that diverts fluid from one system to another. vb. To bypass or divert.

name: sick building syndrome
definition: Health effects or loss of a sense of well-being associated, by those who experience it, with time spent in a certain building or room.

name: silver staining
definition: Method for visualization of macromolecules such as nucleic acids and proteins, typically in electrophoretic gels or formalin-fixed histological sections, based on the reduction of silver salts to metallic silver or formation of crystalline silver compounds.

name: simple reaction time test
definition: Procedure to assess psychomotor speed in which a test subject is presented at irregular intervals with a visual stimulus, such as a coloured dot on a screen, and is asked to press a button immediately after noticing the stimulus.

name: SLUDDE
definition: Acronym for the constellation of signs salivation, lacrymation, urination, defecation, dyspnea/gastrointestinal upset, and emesis.

name: social interaction test
